duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa Huwa, Al-Hayyul-Qayyum. La ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm. Lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard. Man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi-idhnihi. Ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum. Wa la yuhituna bi shay'in min 'ilmihi illa bima sha'a. Wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samawati wal-ard. Wa la ya'uduhu hifdhuhuma. Wa Huwal-'Aliyyul-'Adhim.
duas.translation: Allah! There is no god but He, the Living, the Self-subsisting, Eternal. No slumber can seize Him nor sleep. His are all things in the heavens and on earth. Who is there that can intercede in His presence except as He permits? He knows what is before them and what is behind them. Nor shall they compass any of His knowledge except as He wills. His Throne extends over the heavens and the earth, and He feels no fatigue in guarding and preserving them. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
duas.source: Quran 2:255
duas.virtue: Whoever recites this when he rises in the morning will be protected from jinns until he retires in the evening.

duas.text_arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Asbahna wa asbahal-mulku lillah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa Huwa 'ala kulli shay'in Qadir.
duas.translation: We have reached the morning and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.
duas.source: Abu Dawud 4:317
duas.virtue: Recited once in the morning

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna, wa bika amsayna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namutu, wa ilaykan-nushur.
duas.translation: O Allah, by Your leave we have reached the morning and by Your leave we have reached the evening, by Your leave we live and die and unto You is our resurrection.
duas.source: Tirmidhi 5:466
duas.virtue: Recited in the morning

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma anta Rabbi la ilaha illa anta, khalaqtani wa ana 'abduka, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata'tu, a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana'tu, abu'u laka bini'matika 'alayya, wa abu'u bidhanbi faghfir li fa'innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa anta.
duas.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshipped except You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I abide by Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favor upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for verily none can forgive sins except You.
duas.source: Bukhari 7:150
duas.virtue: Whoever recites this with conviction in the morning and dies before evening enters Paradise.

duas.text_arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
duas.transliteration: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi
duas.translation: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him.
duas.source: Muslim 4:2071
duas.virtue: Whoever recites this 100 times in the morning and evening, his sins will be forgiven even if they are like the foam of the sea.

duas.text_arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
duas.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq.
duas.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
duas.source: Muslim 4:2080
duas.virtue: Whoever recites this three times in the evening will not be harmed by any poisonous sting that night.

duas.text_arabic: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۝ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ ۝ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ۝ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
duas.transliteration: Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad. Allahus-Samad. Lam yalid wa lam yulad. Wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad.
duas.translation: Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal, Absolute. He begets not, nor is He begotten. And there is none like unto Him.
duas.source: Quran 112:1-4
duas.virtue: Reciting this surah three times in the morning and evening is sufficient for everything.

duas.text_arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ۝ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ۝ وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ۝ وَمِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ۝ وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
duas.transliteration: Qul a'udhu bi Rabbil-Falaq. Min sharri ma khalaq. Wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab. Wa min sharrin-naffathati fil-'uqad. Wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad.
duas.translation: Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of the Dawn. From the mischief of created things. From the mischief of Darkness as it overspreads. From the mischief of those who practice secret arts. And from the mischief of the envious one as he practices envy.
duas.source: Quran 113:1-5
duas.virtue: Protection from evil.

duas.text_arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ۝ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ۝ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِنْ شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ۝ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
duas.transliteration: Qul a'udhu bi Rabbin-Nas. Malikin-Nas. Ilahin-Nas. Min sharril-waswaasil-khannas. Alladhi yuwaswisu fi sudurin-nas. Minal-jinnati wan-nas.
duas.translation: Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of Mankind. The King of Mankind. The God of Mankind. From the mischief of the Whisperer who withdraws. Who whispers into the hearts of Mankind. Among Jinns and among men.
duas.source: Quran 114:1-6
duas.virtue: Protection from evil.

duas.text_arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa Huwa 'ala kulli shay'in Qadir.
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.
duas.source: Bukhari & Muslim
duas.virtue: Whoever says this 10 times will have the reward of freeing four slaves.

duas.title_arabic: سبحان الله وبحمده سبحان الله العظيم
duas.text_arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
duas.transliteration: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi, SubhanAllahil-Adhim.
duas.translation: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him. Glory be to Allah the Magnificent.
duas.source: Bukhari
duas.virtue: Two words that are light on the tongue, heavy on the scales, and beloved to the Most Merciful.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَجِرْنِي مِنَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ajirni minan-nar.
duas.translation: O Allah, protect me from the Fire.
duas.source: Abu Dawud
duas.virtue: Said seven times in the morning and evening.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afiyah fid-dunya wal-akhirah. Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyah fi dini wa dunyaya wa ahli wa mali.
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for wellbeing in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and wellbeing in my religion, my worldly affairs, my family and my wealth.
duas.source: Ibn Majah
duas.virtue: The Prophet never missed this dua every morning and evening.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma-hfadhni min bayni yadayya, wa min khalfi, wa 'an yamini, wa 'an shimali, wa min fawqi, wa a'udhu bi'adhamatika an ughtala min tahti.
duas.translation: O Allah, protect me from in front of me, from behind me, from my right, from my left, and from above me. I seek refuge in Your Greatness from being taken unawares from beneath me.
duas.source: Abu Dawud & Ibn Majah
duas.virtue: Complete protection from all directions.

duas.text_arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيًّا
duas.transliteration: Raditu billahi Rabba, wa bil-Islami dina, wa bi-Muhammadin sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallama nabiyya.
duas.translation: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad (peace be upon him) as my Prophet.
duas.source: Abu Dawud
duas.virtue: Paradise becomes obligatory for whoever says this three times.

duas.title_arabic: حسبي الله لا إله إلا هو
duas.text_arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ، عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ، وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
duas.transliteration: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa Huwa, 'alayhi tawakkaltu, wa Huwa Rabbul-'Arshil-'Adhim.
duas.translation: Allah is sufficient for me. None has the right to be worshipped except Him. Upon Him I rely, and He is the Lord of the Magnificent Throne.
duas.source: Abu Dawud
duas.virtue: Whoever says this seven times in the morning and evening, Allah will suffice him in whatever worries him.

duas.text_arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
duas.transliteration: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyumu birahmatika astaghith, aslih li sha'ni kullahu, wa la takilni ila nafsi tarfata 'ayn.
duas.translation: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, by Your mercy I seek help. Rectify for me all of my affairs and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.
duas.source: An-Nasai (Amal al-Yawm wal-Laylah), Al-Hakim
duas.virtue: A supplication seeking Allah's constant care, said morning and evening.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي، وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyah fid-dunya wal-akhirah. Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyah fi dini wa dunyaya wa ahli wa mali. Allahumma-stur 'awrati, wa amin raw'ati.
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and wellbeing in this world and the next. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and wellbeing in my religion, my worldly affairs, my family and my wealth. O Allah, conceal my faults and keep me safe from what I fear.
duas.source: Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah
duas.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ never abandoned these words morning and evening.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءًا، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma 'Alimal-ghaybi wash-shahadah, Fatiras-samawati wal-ard, Rabba kulli shay'in wa malikah, ashhadu an la ilaha illa anta, a'udhu bika min sharri nafsi, wa min sharrish-shaytani wa shirkih, wa an aqtarifa 'ala nafsi su'an, aw ajurrahu ila Muslim.
duas.translation: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things, I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my soul, and from the evil of Satan and his incitement to associate partners with You, and lest I bring evil upon myself or drag it to a Muslim.
duas.source: Abu Dawud, Tirmidhi
duas.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ taught this to be said morning, evening and before sleep.

duas.title_english: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (1)
duas.text_arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
duas.transliteration: a'udhu billahi mina ashshaytani arrajimi allahu la ilaha ila huwa alhayyu alqayyumu la ta'khudhuhu sinahun wala nawmun lahu ma fi assamawati wama fi al'ardi man dha alladhi yashfa'u indahu ila bi'idhnihi ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wama khalfahum wala yuhituna bishay'in min ilmihi ila bima sha wasi'a kursiyyuhu assamawati wal'arda wala ya'uduhu hifdhuhuma wahuwa al'aliyyu al'adhimu
duas.translation: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title_english: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (2)
duas.text_arabic: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ إِلَهِ النَّاسِ مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَ النَّاسِ
duas.transliteration: bsm allah alrhmn alrhym qul huwa allahu ahadun allahu assamadu lam yalid walam yulad walam yakun lahu kufuan ahadun bsm allah alrhmn alrhym qul a'udhu birabbi alfalaqi min sharri ma khalaqa wamin sharri ghasiqin idha waqaba wamin sharri annaffathati fi al'uqadi wamin sharri hasidin idha hasada bsm allah alrhmn alrhym qul a'udhu birabbi annasi maliki annasi ilahi annasi min sharri alwaswasi alkhannasi alladhi yuwaswisu fi suduri annasi mina aljinnahi wa annasi
duas.translation: ([Soorah al-Ikhlaas ] Say, He is Allah, [who is] One, Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, Nor is there to Him any equivalent.)([Soorah al-Falaq ] Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak From the evil of that which He created And from the evil of darkness when it settles And from the evil of the blowers in knots And from the evil of an envier when he envies. )([Soorah an-Naas ]) Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, The Sovereign of mankind. The God of mankind, From the evil of the retreating whisperer - Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind - From among the jinn and mankind.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title_english: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (3)
duas.text_arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ وإذا أمسى قال أمسينا وأمسى الملك للَّه وإذا أمسى قال رب أسألك خير ما في هذه الليلة، وخير ما بعدها، وأعوذ بك من شر ما في هذه الليلة، وشر ما بعدها
duas.transliteration: asbahna wa'asbaha almulku lillahi walhamdu lillahi la ilaha la allahu wahdahu la sharika lahu lahu almulku walahu alhamdu wahuwa ala kulli shay'in qadirun rabbi as'aluka khayra ma fi hadha alyawmi wakhayra ma ba'dahu wa'a'udhu bika min sharri ma fi hadha alyawmi washarri ma ba'dahu rabbi a'udhu bika mina alkasali wasu'i alkibari rabbi a'udhu bika min adhabin fi annari wa'adhabin fi alqabri w'dha msa qal msyna w'msa almlk lah w'dha msa qal rb s'lk khyr ma fy hdhh allylh wkhyr ma b'dha w''wdh bk mn shr ma fy hdhh allylh wshr ma b'dha
duas.translation: We have reached the morning and at this very time unto Allaah, belongs all sovereignty , and all praise is for Allaah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allaah, alone, without any partner, to Him belong all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and the good of what follows it and I take refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil of what follows it . My Lord, I take refuge in You from laziness and senility. My Lord, I take refuge in You from torment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title_english: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (4)
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ وإذا أمسى قال اللَّهم بك أمسينا، وبك أصبحنا، وبك نحيا، وبك نموت، وإليك المصير
duas.transliteration: allahumma bika asbahna wabika amsayna wabika nahya wabika namutu wa'ilayka annushuru w'dha msa qal allahm bk msyna wbk sbhna wbk nhya wbk nmwt w'lyk almsyr
duas.translation: (O Allah, by your leave we have reached the morning and by Your leave we have reached the evening, by Your leave we live and die and unto You is our resurrection.)[In the evening:](O Allah, by Your leave we have reached the evening and by Your leave we have reached the morning, by Your leave we live and die and unto You is our return.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title_english: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (5)
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ، وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلاَئِكَتِكَ، وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ أربعَ مَرَّاتٍ وإذا أمسى قال اللَّهم إني أمسيت
duas.transliteration: allahumma inni asbahtu ushhiduka wa'ushhidu hamalaha arshika wamala'ikatika wajami'a khalqika annaka anta allahu la ilaha ila anta wahdaka la sharika laka wa'anna muhammadan abduka warasuluka rb'a marratin w'dha msa qal allahm ny msyt
duas.translation: (O Allah, verily I have reached the morning and call on You, the bearers of Your throne, Your angles, and all of Your creation to witness that You are Allah, none has the right to be worshipped except You, alone, without partner and that Muhammad is Your Servant and Messenger.) (four times in the morning & evening)(Note: for the evening, one reads (amsaytu) instead of (asbahtu).)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title_english: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (6)
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ وإذا أمسى قال اللَّهم ما أمسى بي
duas.transliteration: allahumma ma asbaha bi min ni'mahin aw bi'ahadin min khalqika faminka wahdaka la sharika laka falaka alhamdu walaka ashshukru w'dha msa qal allahm ma msa by
duas.translation: (O Allah, what blessing I or any of Your creation have risen upon, is from You alone, without partner, so for You is all praise and unto You all thanks.)(…whoever says this in the morning has indeed offered his day’s thanks and whoever says this in the evening has indeed offered his night’s thanks.)(Note: for the evening, one reads (amsa) instead of (asbaha).)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title_english: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (7)
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ، وَالفَقْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ
duas.transliteration: allahumma afini fi badani allahumma afini fi sam'i allahumma afini fi basari la ilaha ila anta allahumma inni a'udhu bika mina alkufri walfaqri wa'a'udhu bika min adhabi alqabri la ilaha ila anta thlatha mrratin
duas.translation: (O Allah, grant my body health, O Allah, grant my hearing health, O Allah, grant my sight health. None has the right to be worshipped except You.)(three times) (O Allah, I take refuge with You from disbelief and poverty, and I take refuge with You from the punishment of the grave. None has the right to be worshipped except You. (three times))
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title_english: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (8)
duas.text_arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ عَلَيهِ تَوَكَّلتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ سَبْعَ مَرّاتٍ
duas.transliteration: hasbiya allahu la ilaha ila huwa alayhi tawakkaltu wahuwa rabbu al'arshi al'adhimi sab'a marratin
duas.translation: Allah is Sufficient for me, none has the right to be worshipped except Him, upon Him I rely and He is Lord of the exalted throne.’ (Recite seven times in Arabic.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title_english: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (9)
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي، وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي، وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَينِ يَدَيَّ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
duas.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka al'afwa wal'afiyaha fi addunya walakhirahi allahumma inni as'aluka al'afwa wal'afiyaha fi dini wadunyaya wa'ahli wamali allahumma astur awrati wamin raw'ati allahumma ahfadhni min bayni yadayya wamin khalfi wa'an yamini wa'an shimali wamin fawqi wa'a'udhu bi'adhamatika an ughtala min tahti
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this life and the next. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religious and worldly affairs, and my family and my wealth. O Allah, veil my weaknesses and set at ease my dismay. O Allah, preserve me from the front and from behind and on my right and on my left and from above, and I take refuge with You lest I be swallowed up by the earth.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title_english: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (10)
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطانِ وَشَرَكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءاً، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
duas.transliteration: allahumma alima alghaybi walshshahadahi fatira assamawati wal'ardi rabba kulli shay'in wamalikahu ashhadu an la ilaha ila anta a'udhu bika min sharri nafsi wamin sharri ashshaytani washarakihi wa'an aqtarifa ala nafsi su'an aw ajurrahu ila muslimin
duas.translation: (O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Creator of the heavens and the Earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things, I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You. I take refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil and shirk of the devil, and from committing wrong against my soul or bringing such upon another Muslim.)(shirk: to associate others with Allah in those things which are specific to Him. This can occur in belief, e.g. to believe that other than Allah has the power to benefit or harm, speech, e.g. to swear by other than Allah and action, e.g. to bow or prostrate to other than Allah.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title_english: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (11)
duas.text_arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلاَ فِي السّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ
duas.transliteration: bismi allahi alladhi la yadurru ma'a asmihi shay'un fi al'ardi wala fi assma'i wahuwa assami'u al'alimu thlatha mrratin
duas.translation: (In the name of Allah with whose name nothing is harmed on earth nor in the heavens and He is The All-Seeing, The All-Knowing.’(three times))
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title_english: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (12)
duas.text_arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، اللَّهُ مَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِفَتْحَهُ، وَنَصْرَهُ، وَنورَهُ، وَبَرَكَتَهُ، وَهُدَاهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيهِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ وإذا أمسى قال أمسينا وأمسى الملك للَّه ربّ العالمين اللَّهم إني أسألك خير هذه الليلة فتحها، ونصرها، ونورها، وبركتها، وهداها، وأعوذ بك من شر ما فيها، وشر ما بعدها
duas.transliteration: asbahna wa'asbaha almulku lillahi rabbi al'alamina allahu ma inni as'aluka khayra hadha alyawmifathahu wanasrahu wanwrahu wabarakatahu wahudahu wa'a'udhu bika min sharri ma fihi washarri ma ba'dahu w'dha msa qal msyna w'msa almlk lah rbb al'almyn allahm ny s'lk khyr hdhh allylh fthha wnsrha wnwrha wbrktha whdaha w''wdh bk mn shr ma fyha wshr ma b'dha
duas.translation: (We have reached the morning and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day, its triumphs and its victories, its light and its blessings and its guidance, and I take refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil that follows it.)[For the evening, the supplication is read as follows:](We have reached the evening and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of tonight, its triumphs and its victories, its light and its blessings and its guidance, and I take refuge in You from the evil of tonight and the evil that follows it.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title_english: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (13)
duas.text_arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ مائة مرَّةٍ
duas.transliteration: subhana allahi wabihamdihi ma'h mrrahin
duas.translation: (How perfect Allah is and I praise Him.)(one hundred times)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title_english: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (14)
duas.text_arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ عشرَ مرَّات، أَوْ مرَّةً واحدةً عندَ الكَسَلِ
duas.transliteration: la ilaha ila allahu wahdahu la sharika lahu lahu almulku walahu alhamdu wahuwa ala kulli shay'in qadirun shra mrrat aw mrrahan wahdhan nda alkasali
duas.translation: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.)( [ten times or once if lazy])
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title_english: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (15)
duas.text_arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ مائةَ مرَّةٍ إذا أصبحَ
duas.transliteration: la ilaha ila allahu wahdahu la sharika lahu lahu almulku walahu alhamdu wahuwa ala kulli shay'in qadirun ma'ha mrrahin dha sbha
duas.translation: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.)((one hundred times every day))
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title_english: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (16)
duas.text_arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ إذا أصبحَ
duas.transliteration: subhana allahi wabihamdihi adada khalqihi warida nafsihi wazinaha arshihi wamidada kalimatihi thlatha mrratin dha sbha
duas.translation: (How perfect Allah is and I praise Him by the number of His creation and His pleasure, and by the weight of His throne, and the ink of His words.)(three times)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title_english: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (17)
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نَافِعاً، وَرِزْقاً طَيِّباً، وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً إذا أصبحَ
duas.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka ilman nafi'an warizqan tayyiban wa'amalan mutaqabbalan dha sbha
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge which is beneficial and sustenance which is good, and deeds which are acceptable.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title_english: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (18)
duas.text_arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ فِي الْيَوْمِ
duas.transliteration: astaghfiru allaha wa'atubu ilayhi mia'aha marrahin fi alyawmi
duas.translation: I seek Allaah’s forgiveness and I turn to Him in repentance.’ [one hundred times a day]
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title_english: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (19)
duas.text_arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ إذا أمسى
duas.transliteration: a'udhu bikalimati allahi attammati min sharri ma khalaqa thlatha mrratin dha msa
duas.translation: (I take refuge in Allah’s perfect words from the evil He has created.)(three times in the evening)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.title_english: Words of remembrance for morning and evening (20)
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبَيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عشرَ مرَّاتٍ
duas.transliteration: allahumma salli wasallim ala nabayyina muhammadin shra mrratin
duas.translation: O Allaah, send prayers and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.’ [ten times]
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Words of remembrance for morning and evening

duas.text_arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Amsayna wa amsal-mulku lillah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa Huwa 'ala kulli shay'in Qadir.
duas.translation: We have reached the evening and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner.
duas.source: Abu Dawud 4:317
duas.virtue: Said once in the evening.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma bika amsayna, wa bika asbahna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namutu, wa ilaykal-masir.
duas.translation: O Allah, by Your leave we have reached the evening and by Your leave we have reached the morning, by Your leave we live and die and unto You is our return.
duas.source: Tirmidhi 5:466
duas.virtue: Recited in the evening.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa Huwa, Al-Hayyul-Qayyum...
duas.translation: Allah! There is no god but He, the Living, the Self-subsisting, Eternal...
duas.source: Quran 2:255
duas.virtue: Protection until morning.

duas.text_arabic: آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۚ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِ ۚ وَقَالُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
duas.transliteration: Amanar-Rasulu bima unzila ilayhi mir-Rabbihi wal-mu'minun...
duas.translation: The Messenger believes in what has been sent down to him from his Lord, and so do the believers...
duas.virtue: Sufficient protection for the night.

duas.text_arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'asmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i wa Huwas-Sami'ul-'Alim.
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, All-Knowing.
duas.source: Abu Dawud & Tirmidhi
duas.virtue: Nothing will harm whoever says this three times.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma anta Rabbi la ilaha illa anta, khalaqtani wa ana 'abduka, wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata'tu, a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana'tu, abu'u laka bini'matika 'alayya, wa abu'u bidhanbi faghfir li fa'innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa anta.
duas.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshipped except You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I abide by Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favor upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none can forgive sins except You.
duas.source: Bukhari
duas.virtue: Whoever says it in the evening with conviction and dies that night enters Paradise.

duas.text_arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
duas.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq.
duas.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
duas.source: Muslim
duas.virtue: Whoever says it three times in the evening will not be harmed by any sting that night.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyah fid-dunya wal-akhirah. Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyah fi dini wa dunyaya wa ahli wa mali.
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and wellbeing in this world and the next. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and wellbeing in my religion, my worldly affairs, my family and my wealth.
duas.source: Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah
duas.virtue: Said by the Prophet ﷺ each evening.

duas.text_arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ، عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ، وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
duas.transliteration: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa Huwa, 'alayhi tawakkaltu, wa Huwa Rabbul-'Arshil-'Adhim.
duas.translation: Allah is sufficient for me. None has the right to be worshipped except Him. Upon Him I rely, and He is the Lord of the Magnificent Throne.
duas.source: Abu Dawud
duas.virtue: Whoever says this seven times in the evening, Allah will suffice him in whatever worries him.

duas.text_arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ
duas.transliteration: Amsayna 'ala fitratil-Islam, wa 'ala kalimatil-ikhlas, wa 'ala dini nabiyyina Muhammadin sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, wa 'ala millati abina Ibrahima hanifan musliman wa ma kana minal-mushrikin.
duas.translation: We have reached the evening upon the natural religion of Islam, the word of pure faith, the religion of our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and the way of our father Ibrahim, who was upright, a Muslim, and not of those who associate partners with Allah.
duas.source: Ahmad
duas.virtue: A renewal of faith upon reaching the evening.

duas.text_arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيًّا
duas.transliteration: Raditu billahi Rabba, wa bil-Islami dina, wa bi-Muhammadin sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallama nabiyya.
duas.translation: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad ﷺ as my Prophet.
duas.source: Abu Dawud, Tirmidhi
duas.virtue: Allah has promised to please whoever says this three times morning and evening.

duas.text_arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
duas.transliteration: Astaghfirullah
duas.translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah.
duas.source: Muslim
duas.virtue: Said three times after each obligatory prayer.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma antas-Salam wa minkas-salam, tabarakta ya dhal-jalali wal-ikram.
duas.translation: O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace. Blessed are You, O Owner of majesty and honor.
duas.source: Muslim
duas.virtue: The Prophet would say this after every prayer.

duas.text_arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: SubhanAllah
duas.translation: Glory be to Allah.
duas.source: Bukhari & Muslim
duas.virtue: Said 33 times after each obligatory prayer.

duas.text_arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdulillah
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah.
duas.source: Bukhari & Muslim
duas.virtue: Said 33 times after each obligatory prayer.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
duas.transliteration: Allahu Akbar
duas.translation: Allah is the Greatest.
duas.source: Bukhari & Muslim
duas.virtue: Said 34 times to complete 100.

duas.title_arabic: لا إله إلا الله بعد التسبيح
duas.text_arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa Huwa 'ala kulli shay'in Qadir.
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, with no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He is Able to do all things.
duas.source: Muslim
duas.virtue: Said once after completing the tasbih.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ...
duas.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa Huwa, Al-Hayyul-Qayyum...
duas.translation: Allah! There is no god but He, the Living, the Self-subsisting...
duas.source: Nasai
duas.virtue: Nothing prevents the one who recites this after every prayer from entering Paradise except death.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبُخْلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ أُرَدَّ إِلَى أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الدُّنْيَا وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-bukhl, wa a'udhu bika minal-jubn, wa a'udhu bika min an uradda ila ardhalil-'umur, wa a'udhu bika min fitnatid-dunya wa 'adhabil-qabr.
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from miserliness, cowardice, being returned to a feeble old age, the trials of this world, and the punishment of the grave.
duas.source: Bukhari
duas.virtue: Protection from various evils.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ، وَشُكْرِكَ، وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma a'inni 'ala dhikrika, wa shukrika, wa husni 'ibadatik.
duas.translation: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You in the best manner.
duas.source: Abu Dawud, An-Nasai
duas.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ advised Mu'adh to never omit this after every prayer.

duas.title_arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من الكفر
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ، وَالْفَقْرِ، وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-kufr, wal-faqr, wa 'adhabil-qabr.
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from disbelief, poverty, and the punishment of the grave.
duas.source: An-Nasai, Ahmad
duas.virtue: Said seeking protection in this life and the next.

duas.text_arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ ثَلاَثَاً اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلاَمُ، وَمِنْكَ السَّلاَمُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
duas.transliteration: astaghfiru allaha thalathan allahumma anta assalamu waminka assalamu tabarakta ya dha aljalali wal'ikrami
duas.translation: (I ask Allah for forgiveness.(three times) (O Allah, You are As-Salam and from You is all peace, blessed are You, O Possessor of majesty and honour.) (AS-Salam: The One Who is free from all defects and deficiencies.))
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What to say after completing the prayer

duas.text_arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ثلاثاً، اللَّهُمَّ لاَ مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلاَ مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلاَ يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الجَدُّ
duas.transliteration: la ilaha ila allahu wahdahu la sharika lahu lahu almulku walahu alhamdu wahuwa ala kulli shay'in qadirun thlathan allahumma la mani'a lima a'tayta wala mu'tiya lima mana'ta wala yanfa'u dha aljaddi minka aljaddu
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent.O Allah, none can prevent what You have willed to bestow and none can bestow what You have willed to prevent, and no wealth or majesty can benefit anyone, as from You is all wealth and majesty.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What to say after completing the prayer

duas.text_arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَلاَ نَعْبُدُ إِلاَّ إِيَّاهُ لَهُ النِّعْمَةُ وَلَهُ الْفَضْلُ وَلَهُ الثَّنَاءُ الْحَسَنُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الكَافِرُونَ
duas.transliteration: la ilaha ila allahu wahdahu la sharika lahu lahu almulku walahu alhamdu wahuwa ala kulli shay'in qadirun la hawla wala quwwaha ila billahi la ilaha ila allahu wala na'budu ila iyyahu lahu anni'mahu walahu alfadlu walahu aththana'u alhasanu la ilaha ila allahu mukhlisina lahu addina walaw kariha alkafiruna
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent. There is no might nor power except with Allah, none has the right to be worshipped except Allah and we worship none except Him. For Him is all favour, grace, and glorious praise. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and we are sincere in faith and devotion to Him although the disbelievers detest it.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What to say after completing the prayer

duas.text_arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ ثلاثاً وثلاثين لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: subhana allahi walhamdu lillahi wallahu akbaru thlathan wthlathyn la ilaha ila allahu wahdahu la sharika lahu lahu almulku walahu alhamdu wahuwa ala kulli shay'in qadirun
duas.translation: (How perfect Allah is, all praise is for Allah, and Allah is the greatest.(thirty-three times) (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent.))
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What to say after completing the prayer

duas.text_arabic: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ، بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ،بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ إِلَهِ النَّاسِ مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَ النَّاسِ بَعْدَ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ
duas.transliteration: bsm allah alrhmn alrhym qul huwa allahu ahadun allahu assamadu lam yalid walam yulad walam yakun lahu kufuan ahadun bsm allah alrhmn alrhym qul a'udhu birabbi alfalaqi min sharri ma khalaqa wamin sharri ghasiqin idha waqaba wamin sharri annaffathati fi al'uqadi wamin sharri hasidin idha hasadabsm allah alrhmn alrhym qul a'udhu birabbi annasi maliki annasi ilahi annasi min sharri alwaswasi alkhannasi alladhi yuwaswisu fi suduri annasi mina aljinnahi wa annasi ba'da kulli salahin
duas.translation: The following three Soorahs should be recited once after Zuhr, 'Asr and 'Ishaa prayers and thrice after the Fajr and Maghrib prayers.[Soorah al-Ikhlaas ] [Soorah al-Falaq ] [Soorah an-Naas ]
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What to say after completing the prayer

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاءَ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ عَقِبَ كلِّ صَلاَةٍ
duas.transliteration: allahu la ilaha ila huwa alhayyu alqayyumu la ta'khudhuhu sinahun wala nawmun lahu ma fi assamawati wama fi al'ardi man dha alladhi yashfa'u indahu ila bi'idhnihi ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wama khalfahum wala yuhituna bishay'in min ilmihi ila bima sha'a wasi'a kursiyyuhu assamawati wal'arda wala ya'uduhu hifdhuhuma wahuwa al'aliyyu al'adhimu aqiba klli salahin
duas.translation: It is also from the Sunnah to recite Aayat ul-Kursee after each prayer:[Soorah al-Baqarah, Aayah 255]
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What to say after completing the prayer

duas.text_arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ عَشْرَ مَرّاتٍ بَعْدَ صَلاةِ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالصُّبْحِ
duas.transliteration: la ilaha ila allahu wahdahu la sharika lahu lahu almulku walahu alhamdu yuhyi wayumitu wahuwa ala kulli shay'in qadirun ashra marratin ba'da salahi almaghribi walssubhi
duas.translation: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, He gives life and causes death and He is over all things omnipotent.(ten times after the maghrib and fajr prayers))
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What to say after completing the prayer

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نافِعاً، وَرِزْقاً طَيِّباً، وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً بَعْدَ السّلامِ مِنْ صَلاَةِ الفَجْرِ
duas.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka ilman nafi'an warizqan tayyiban wa'amalan mutaqabbalan ba'da asslami min salahi alfajri
duas.translation: (O Allah, I ask You for knowledge which is beneficial and sustenance which is good, and deeds which are acceptable.)(To be said after giving salam for the fajr prayer)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What to say after completing the prayer

duas.text_arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdulillahil-ladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur.
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us and unto Him is the resurrection.
duas.source: Bukhari 11:113
duas.virtue: Said upon waking up.

duas.text_arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, wa Huwa 'ala kulli shay'in Qadir. SubhanAllah, wal-hamdulillah, wa la ilaha illallah, wallahu Akbar, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, with no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He is Able to do all things. Glory be to Allah, all praise is for Allah, there is no god but Allah, Allah is the Greatest, and there is no might nor power except with Allah.
duas.source: Bukhari
duas.virtue: Whoever wakes and says this, his dua will be answered.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna wa bika amsayna wa bika nahya wa bika namutu wa ilaykan-nushur.
duas.translation: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening, by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.
duas.source: Tirmidhi
duas.virtue: Said in the morning after waking.

duas.text_arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَريكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ للَّهِ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكبَرُ، وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبِّ اغْفرْ لِي
duas.transliteration: la ilaha ila allahu wahdahu la sharyka lahu lahu almulku walahu alhamdu wahuwa ala kulli shay'in qadirun subhana allahi walhamdu lahi wala ilaha ila allahu wallahu akbaru wala hawla wala quwwaha ila billahi al'aliyyi al'adhimi rabbi aghfr li
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone without associate, to Him belongs sovereignty and praise and He is over all things wholly capable. How perfect Allah is, and all praise is for Allah, and none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Allah is the greatest and there is no power nor might except with Allah, The Most High, The Supreme.O my Lord forgive me
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — supplications for when you wake up

duas.text_arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي فِي جَسَدِي، وَرَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي، وَأَذِنَ لي بِذِكْرِهِ
duas.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi alladhi afani fi jasadi waradda alayya ruhi wa'adhina ly bidhikrihi
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah who restored to me my health and returned my soul and has allowed me to remember Him.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — supplications for when you wake up

duas.text_arabic: إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَاخْتِلاَفِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ لَآيَاتٍ لأُوْلِي الألْبَابِ الَّذِينَ يَذْكُرُونَ اللَّهَ قِيَاماً وَقُعُوداً وَعَلَىَ جُنُوبِهِمْ وَيَتَفَكَّرُونَ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَذا بَاطِلاً سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَن تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍ رَّبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِياً يُنَادِي لِلإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُواْ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الأبْرَارِ رَبَّنَا وَآتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَى رُسُلِكَ وَلاَ تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّكَ لاَ تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ فَاسْتَجَابَ لَهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ أَنِّي لاَ أُضِيعُ عَمَلَ عَامِلٍ مِّنكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَى بَعْضُكُم مِّن بَعْضٍ فَالَّذِينَ هَاجَرُواْ وَأُخْرِجُواْ مِن دِيَارِهِمْ وَأُوذُواْ فِي سَبِيلِي وَقَاتَلُواْ وَقُتِلُواْ لأُكَفِّرَنَّ عَنْهُمْ سَيِّئَاتِهِمْ وَلأُدْخِلَنَّهُمْ جَنَّاتٍ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا الأَنْهَارُ ثَوَاباً مِّن عِندِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ عِندَهُ حُسْنُ الثَّوَابِ لاَ يَغُرَّنَّكَ تَقَلُّبُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي الْبِلاَدِ مَتَاعٌ قَلِيلٌ ثُمَّ مَأْوَاهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ وَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ لَكِنِ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوْاْ رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الأَنْهَارُ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا نُزُلاً مِّنْ عِندِ اللَّهِ وَمَا عِندَ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ لِّلأَبْرَارِ وَإِنَّ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ لَمَن يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِمْ خَاشِعِينَ لِلَّهِ لاَ يَشْتَرُونَ بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ ثَمَناً قَلِيلاً أُوْلَئِكَ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ سَرِيعُ الْحِسَابِ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ اصْبِرُواْ وَصَابِرُواْ وَرَابِطُواْ وَاتَّقُواْ اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
duas.transliteration: inna fi khalqi assamawati wal'ardi wakhtilafi allayli walnnahari layatin l'uli al'lbabi alladhina yadhkuruna allaha qiyaman waqu'udan wa'ala junubihim wayatafakkaruna fi khalqi assamawati wal'ardi rabbana ma khalaqta hadha batilan subhanaka faqina adhaba annari rabbana innaka man tudkhili annara faqad akhzaytahu wama lildhdhalimina min ansarin rabbana innana sami'na munadian yunadi lil'imani an aminua birabbikum famanna rabbana faghfir lana dhunubana wakaffir anna sayyi'atina watawaffana ma'a al'brari rabbana watina ma wa'adttana ala rusulika wala tukhzina yawma alqiyamahi innaka la tukhlifu almi'ada fastajaba lahum rabbuhum anni la udi'u amala amilin minkum min dhakarin aw untha ba'dukum min ba'din falladhina hajarua wa'ukhrijua min diyarihim wa'udhua fi sabili waqatalua waqutilua l'ukaffiranna anhum sayyi'atihim wal'udkhilannahum jannatin tajri min tahtiha al'anharu thawaban min indi allahi wallahu indahu husnu aththawabi la yaghurrannaka taqallubu alladhina kafarua fi albiladi mata'un qalilun thumma ma'wahum jahannamu wabi'sa almihadu lakini alladhina attaqawa rabbahum lahum jannatun tajri min tahtiha al'anharu khalidina fiha nuzulan min indi allahi wama inda allahi khayrun lil'abrari wa'inna min ahli alkitabi laman yu'minu billahi wama unzila ilaykum wama unzila ilayhim khashi'ina lillahi la yashtaruna biayati allahi thamanan qalilan ula'ika lahum ajruhum inda rabbihim inna allaha sari'u alhisabi ya ayyuha alladhina amanua asbirua wasabirua warabitua wattaqua allaha la'allakum tuflihuna
duas.translation: Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth and the alternation of the night and the day are signs for those of understanding. Who remember Allah while standing or sitting or [lying] on their sides and give thought to the creation of the heavens and the earth, [saying], Our Lord, You did not create this aimlessly; exalted are You [above such a thing]; then protect us from the punishment of the Fire. Our Lord, indeed whoever You admit to the Fire - You have disgraced him, and for the wrongdoers there are no helpers. Our Lord, indeed we have heard a caller calling to faith, [saying], 'Believe in your Lord,' and we have believed. Our Lord, so forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die with the righteous. Our Lord, and grant us what You promised us through Your messengers and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, You do not fail in [Your] promise. And their Lord responded to them, Never will I allow to be lost the work of [any] worker among you, whether male or female; you are of one another. So those who emigrated or were evicted from their homes or were harmed in My cause or fought or were killed - I will surely remove from them their misdeeds, and I will surely admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow as reward from Allah, and Allah has with Him the best reward. Be not deceived by the [uninhibited] movement of the disbelievers throughout the land. [It is but] a small enjoyment; then their [final] refuge is Hell, and wretched is the resting place. But those who feared their Lord will have gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding eternally therein, as accommodation from Allah. And that which is with Allah is best for the righteous. And indeed, among the People of the Scripture are those who believe in Allah and what was revealed to you and what was revealed to them, [being] humbly submissive to Allah. They do not exchange the verses of Allah for a small price.Those will have their reward with their Lord. Indeed, Allah is swift in account. O you who have believed, persevere and endure and remain stationed and fear Allah that you may be successful.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — supplications for when you wake up

duas.text_arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
duas.transliteration: Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya.
duas.translation: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
duas.source: Bukhari
duas.virtue: Said when going to sleep.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لَا مَلْجَأَ وَلَا مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma aslamtu nafsi ilayk, wa fawwadtu amri ilayk, wa wajjahtu wajhi ilayk, wa alja'tu dhahri ilayk, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilayk, la malja'a wa la manja minka illa ilayk. Amantu bikitabikal-ladhi anzalt, wa binabiyyikal-ladhi arsalt.
duas.translation: O Allah, I submit myself to You, I entrust my affairs to You, I turn my face to You, I lean my back on You, out of hope and fear of You. There is no refuge or safe haven from You except with You. I believe in Your Book which You revealed and Your Prophet whom You sent.
duas.source: Bukhari & Muslim
duas.virtue: If you die that night, you die upon the fitrah.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma qini 'adhabaka yawma tab'athu 'ibadak.
duas.translation: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You resurrect Your servants.
duas.source: Abu Dawud
duas.virtue: Said three times before sleeping.

duas.text_arabic: قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ ۝ لَا أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ ۝ وَلَا أَنتُمْ عَابِدُونَ مَا أَعْبُدُ ۝ وَلَا أَنَا عَابِدٌ مَّا عَبَدتُّمْ ۝ وَلَا أَنتُمْ عَابِدُونَ مَا أَعْبُدُ ۝ لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِيَ دِينِ
duas.transliteration: Qul ya ayyuhal-kafirun. La a'budu ma ta'budun. Wa la antum 'abiduna ma a'bud. Wa la ana 'abidum ma 'abadtum. Wa la antum 'abiduna ma a'bud. Lakum dinukum wa liya din.
duas.translation: Say: O disbelievers, I do not worship what you worship. Nor are you worshippers of what I worship. Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship. Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship. For you is your religion, and for me is my religion.
duas.source: Quran 109
duas.virtue: A declaration of freedom from shirk before sleep.

duas.text_arabic: تَبَارَكَ الَّذِي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ...
duas.transliteration: Tabarakal-ladhi biyadihil-mulku wa Huwa 'ala kulli shay'in Qadir...
duas.translation: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent...
duas.source: Quran 67
duas.virtue: It intercedes for its reader until he is forgiven.

duas.text_arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ (٣٣)، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (٣٣)، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (٣٤)
duas.transliteration: SubhanAllah (33), wal-hamdulillah (33), wallahu Akbar (34).
duas.translation: Glory be to Allah (33 times), all praise is for Allah (33 times), Allah is the Greatest (34 times).
duas.source: Bukhari & Muslim
duas.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ taught this to Fatimah and 'Ali as better for them than a servant.

duas.title_english: The Three Quls and Wiping the Body
duas.text_arabic: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ، قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ، قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ
duas.transliteration: Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad, Qul a'udhu bi Rabbil-Falaq, Qul a'udhu bi Rabbin-Nas.
duas.translation: Recite Surah Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Nas, then blow into the palms and wipe over the body, starting with the head, face and front, three times.
duas.source: Bukhari
duas.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ did this every night before sleeping.

duas.title_english: Seeking Refuge from the Evil of Creation
duas.title_arabic: أعوذ بكلمات الله التامات قبل النوم
duas.text_arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
duas.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq.
duas.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
duas.source: Muslim
duas.virtue: Protection through the night from every harm.

duas.text_arabic: يَجْمَعُ كَفَّيْهِ ثُمَّ يَنْفُثُ فِيهِمَا فَيَقْرَأُ فِيهِمَابسم الله الرحمن الرحيم قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ إِلَهِ النَّاسِ مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَ النَّاسِ ثُمَّ يَمْسَحُ بِهِمَا مَا اسْتَطَاعَ مِنْ جَسَدِهِ يَبْدَأُ بِهِمَا عَلَى رَأْسِهِ وَوَجْهِهِ وَمَا أَقبَلَ مِنْ جَسَدِهِ يفعلُ ذلك ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ
duas.transliteration: yajma'u kaffayhi thumma yanfuthu fihima fayaqra'u fihimabsm allah alrhmn alrhym qul huwa allahu ahadun allahu assamadu lam yalid walam yulad walam yakun lahu kufuan ahadun bsm allah alrhmn alrhym qul a'udhu birabbi alfalaqi min sharri ma khalaqa wamin sharri ghasiqin idha waqaba wamin sharri annaffathati fi al'uqadi wamin sharri hasidin idha hasada bsm allah alrhmn alrhym qul a'udhu birabbi annasi maliki annasi ilahi annasi min sharri alwaswasi alkhannasi alladhi yuwaswisu fi suduri annasi mina aljinnahi wa annasi thumma yamsahu bihima ma astata'a min jasadihi yabda'u bihima ala ra'sihi wawajhihi wama aqbala min jasadihi yf'lu dhlk thlatha mrratin
duas.translation: (When retiring to his bed every night, the Prophet would hold his palms together, spit (A form of spitting comprising mainly of air with little spittle) in them, recite the last three chapters (Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, An-Nas) of the Quran and then wipe over his entire body as much as possible with his hands, beginning with his head and face and then all parts of the body, he would do this three times.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What to say before sleeping

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْ دَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
duas.transliteration: allahu la ilaha ila huwa alhayyu alqayyumu la ta'khudhuhu sinahun wala nawmun lahu ma fi assamawati wama fi al'ardi man dha alladhi yashfa'u in dahu ila bi'idhnihi ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wama khalfahum wala yuhituna bishay'in min ilmihi ila bima sha wasi'a kursiyyuhu assamawati wal'arda wala ya'uduhu hifdhuhuma wahuwa al'aliyyu al'adhimu
duas.translation: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What to say before sleeping

duas.text_arabic: آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلآئِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لاَ نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِ وَقَالُواْ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ لاَ يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْساً إِلاَّ وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ رَبَّنَا لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلاَ تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْراً كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلاَ تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لاَ طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَآ أَنتَ مَوْلاَنَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: amana arrasulu bima unzila ilayhi min rabbihi walmu'minuna kullun amana billahi wamala'ikatihi wakutubihi warusulihi la nufarriqu bayna ahadin min rusulihi waqalua sami'na wa'ata'na ghufranaka rabbana wa'ilayka almasiru la yukallifu allahu nafsan ila wus'aha laha ma kasabat wa'alayha ma aktasabat rabbana la tu'akhidhna in nasina aw akhta'na rabbana wala tahmil alayna isran kama hamaltahu ala alladhina min qablina rabbana wala tuhammilna ma la taqaha lana bihi wa'fu anna waghfir lana warhamna anta mawlana fansurna ala alqawmi alkafirina
duas.translation: The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and [so have] the believers. All of them have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers, [saying], We make no distinction between any of His messengers. And they say, We hear and we obey. [We seek] Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the [final] destination. Allah does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity. It will have [the consequence of] what [good] it has gained, and it will bear [the consequence of] what [evil] it has earned. Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What to say before sleeping

duas.text_arabic: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، فَإِن أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا، بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
duas.transliteration: biasmika rabbi wada'tu janbi wabika arfa'uhu fa'in amsakta nafsi farhamha wa'in arsaltaha fahfadhha bima tahfadhu bihi ibadaka assalihina
duas.translation: In Your name my Lord, I lie down and in Your name I rise, so if You should take my soul then have mercy upon it, and if You should return my soul then protect it in the manner You do so with Your righteous servants.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What to say before sleeping

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ خَلَقْتَ نَفْسِي وَأَنْتَ تَوَفَّاهَا، لَكَ مَمَاتُهَا وَمَحْياهَا، إِنْ أَحْيَيْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا، وَإِنْ أَمَتَّهَا فَاغْفِرْ لَهَا اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ العَافِيَةَ
duas.transliteration: allahumma innaka khalaqta nafsi wa'anta tawaffaha laka mamatuha wamahyaha in ahyaytaha fahfadhha wa'in amattaha faghfir laha allahumma inni as'aluka al'afiyaha
duas.translation: O Allah, verily You have created my soul and You shall take it’s life, to You belongs it’s life and death. If You should keep my soul alive then protect it, and if You should take it’s life then forgive it. O Allah, I ask You to grant me good health.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What to say before sleeping

duas.text_arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ ثلاثاً وثلاثين وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ثلاثاً وثلاثين وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ أربعاً وثلاثينَ
duas.transliteration: subhana allahi thlathan wthlathyn walhamdu lillahi thlathan wthlathyn wallahu akbaru rb'an wthlathyna
duas.translation: (How Perfect Allah is. (thirty-three times) All praise is for Allah.(thirty-three times) Allah is the greatest.(thirty-four times))
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What to say before sleeping

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبَّ الأَرْضِ، وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَى، وَمُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالْإِنْجِيلِ، وَالْفُرْقَانِ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الأَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الآخِرُ فَلَيسَ بَعْدَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَيْءٌ، وَأَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُونَكَ شَيْءٌ، اقْضِ عَنَّا الدَّيْنَ وَأَغْنِنَا مِنَ الْفَقْرِ
duas.transliteration: allahumma rabba assamawati assab'i warabba al'ardi warabba al'arshi al'adhimi rabbana warabba kulli shay'in faliqa alhabbi walnnawa wamunzila attawrahi wal'injili walfurqani a'udhu bika min sharri kulli shay'in anta akhidhun binasiyatihi allahumma anta al'awwalu falaysa qablaka shay'un wa'anta alakhiru falaysa ba'daka shay'un wa'anta adhdhahiru falaysa fawqaka shay'un wa'anta albatinu falaysa dunaka shay'un aqdi anna addayna wa'aghnina mina alfaqri
duas.translation: (O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and the exalted throne, our Lord and Lord of all things, Splitter of the seed and the date stone, Revealer of the Tawrah, the Injeel and the Furqan, I take refuge in You from the evil of all things You shall seize by the forelock (i.e. You have total mastery over). O Allah, You are The First so there is nothing before You and You are The Last so there is nothing after You.You are Aththahir so there is nothing above You and You are Al-Batin so there is nothing closer than You.Settle our debt for us and spare us from poverty.)(Tawrah: The book revealed to Moosa u.)(Injeel: The book revealed to Easa u.)(Furqan: One of the many names of the Quran, means: The Criterion which distinguishes between truth and falsehood.)(Aththahir: Indicates the greatness of His attributes and the insignificance of every single creation in respect to His greatness and Highness, for He is above all of His creation as regards His essence and attributes.)(Al-Batin: Indicates His awareness and knowledge of all secrets, of that which is in the hearts and the most intimate of things just as it indicates His closeness and nearness to all in a manner which befits His majesty.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What to say before sleeping

duas.text_arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا، وَكَفَانَا، وَآوَانَا، فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ لاَ كَافِيَ لَهُ وَلاَ مُؤْوِيَ
duas.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi alladhi at'amana wasaqana wakafana wawana fakam mimman la kafiya lahu wala mu'wiya
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah, Who fed us and gave us drink, and Who is sufficient for us and has sheltered us, for how many have none to suffice them or shelter them.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What to say before sleeping

duas.text_arabic: يَقْرَأُ الم تَنْزِيلَ السَّجْدَة ِ، وَتَبَارَكَ الَّذي بِيَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ
duas.transliteration: yaqra'u alm tanzila assajdah watabaraka alladhy biyadihi almulku
duas.translation: (The Prophet never used to sleep until he had recited Soorat As-Sajdah (chapter 32) and Soorat Al-Mulk (chapter 67).)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What to say before sleeping

duas.title_english: To say if you stir in the night
duas.text_arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهّارُ، رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الْعَزيزُ الْغَفَّارُ
duas.transliteration: la ilaha ila allahu alwahidu alqahharu rabbu assamawati wal'ardi wama baynahuma al'azyzu alghaffaru
duas.translation: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, The One, AL-Qahhar.Lord of the heavens and the Earth and all between them, The Exalted in Might, The Oft-Forgiving.)(AL-Qahhar:The One Who has subdued all of creation and Whom all of creation are subservient to. All movements occur by His will.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocation to say if you stir in the night

duas.title_english: You are afraid to go to sleep or feel lonely and depressed
duas.text_arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ، وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ، وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّياطِينِ وَأَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ
duas.transliteration: a'udhu bikalimati allahi attammati min ghadabihi wa'iqabihi washarri ibadihi wamin hamazati ashshayatini wa'an yahduruni
duas.translation: I take refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger and punishment, and from the evil of His servants, and from the madness and appearance of devils.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What to say if you are afraid to go to sleep or feel lonely and depressed

duas.title_english: You have a bad dream or nightmare (1)
duas.text_arabic: يَنْفُثُ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ ثلاثاً
duas.transliteration: yanfuthu an yasarihi thlathan
duas.translation: [((Spit on your left three times)(Spit: A form of spitting comprising mainly of air with little spittle)) - (Seek refuge in Allah from shaytan and the evil of what you saw (Three Times)) - (Do not relate it to anyone) - (Turn and sleep on the opposite side to which you were sleeping on previously.) - (Get up and pray if you so desire.) ]
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What to do if you have a bad dream or nightmare

duas.title_english: You have a bad dream or nightmare (2)
duas.text_arabic: ويَقُومُ يُصَلِّي إِنْ أَرَادَ ذَلِكَ
duas.transliteration: wyaqumu yusalli in arada dhalika
duas.translation: Get up and pray if you so desire.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What to do if you have a bad dream or nightmare

duas.text_arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا
duas.transliteration: Bismillahi walajna, wa bismillahi kharajna, wa 'ala Allahi rabbina tawakkalna.
duas.translation: In the name of Allah we enter, and in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we place our trust.
duas.source: Abu Dawud
duas.virtue: Shaytan says: You have no lodging here.

duas.text_arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
duas.transliteration: Assalamu 'alaykum wa rahmatullahi wa barakatuh.
duas.translation: Peace be upon you and the mercy of Allah and His blessings.
duas.source: Bukhari
duas.virtue: Spreading peace brings blessings to the home.

duas.text_arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا، ثُمَّ لِيُسَلِّمْ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ
duas.transliteration: bismi allahi walajna wabismi allahi kharajna wa'ala allahi rabbina tawakkalna thumma liyusallim ala ahlihi
duas.translation: In the name of Allah we enter and in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we place our trust.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What to say when entering the home

duas.text_arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillah, tawakkaltu 'alallah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might nor power except with Allah.
duas.source: Abu Dawud & Tirmidhi
duas.virtue: He is guided, protected, and shaytan turns away from him.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَضِلَّ أَوْ أُضَلَّ، أَوْ أَزِلَّ أَوْ أُزَلَّ، أَوْ أَظْلِمَ أَوْ أُظْلَمَ، أَوْ أَجْهَلَ أَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَيَّ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika an adilla aw udall, aw azilla aw uzall, aw adhlima aw udhlam, aw ajhala aw yujhala 'alayy.
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from leading others astray or being led astray, from slipping or being caused to slip, from oppressing or being oppressed, from behaving ignorantly or being treated ignorantly.
duas.source: Abu Dawud & Tirmidhi
duas.virtue: Comprehensive protection when leaving home.

duas.text_arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ، وَبِوَجْهِهِ الْكَرِيمِ، وَسُلْطَانِهِ الْقَدِيمِ، مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ. بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
duas.transliteration: A'udhu billahil-'Adhim, wa biwajhihil-Karim, wa sultanihil-qadim, minash-shaytanir-rajim. Bismillah, wassalatu wassalamu 'ala Rasulillah. Allahumma-ftah li abwaba rahmatik.
duas.translation: I seek refuge in Allah the Magnificent, and in His Noble Face, and His Eternal Authority, from the accursed devil. In the name of Allah, and prayers and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, open for me the doors of Your mercy.
duas.source: Abu Dawud & Muslim
duas.virtue: Protection from shaytan upon entering the mosque.

duas.text_arabic: يَبْدَأُ بِرِجْلِهِ الْيُمْنَى، وَيَقُولُ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ العَظِيمِ، وَبِوَجْهِهِ الْكَرِيمِ، وَسُلْطَانِهِ الْقَدِيمِ، مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
duas.transliteration: yabda'u birijlihi alyumna wayaqulu a'udhu billahi al'adhimi wabiwajhihi alkarimi wasultanihi alqadimi mina ashshaytani arrajimi bismi allahi walssalahu walssalamu ala rasuli allahi allahumma aftah li abwaba rahmatika
duas.translation: I take refuge with Allah, The Supreme and with His Noble Face, and His eternal authority from the accursed devil. In the name of Allah, and prayers and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, open the gates of Your mercy for me.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocation for entering the mosque

duas.text_arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
duas.transliteration: Bismillah, wassalatu wassalamu 'ala Rasulillah. Allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik.
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, and prayers and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, I ask You of Your favor.
duas.source: Muslim
duas.virtue: Ask Allah for His bounty when leaving.

duas.text_arabic: يَبْدَأُ بِرِجْلِهِ الْيُسْرَى وَيَقُولُ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَالصّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِك، اللَّهُمَّ اعْصِمْنِي مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
duas.transliteration: yabda'u birijlihi alyusra wayaqulu bismi allahi walsslahu walssalamu ala rasuli allahi allahumma inni as'aluka min fadlik allahumma a'simni mina ashshaytani arrajimi
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, and prayers and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, I ask You from Your favour. O Allah, guard me from the accursed devil.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocation for leaving the mosque

duas.text_arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillah
duas.translation: In the name of Allah.
duas.source: Bukhari & Muslim
duas.virtue: Shaytan cannot partake of the food.

duas.text_arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ فِي أَوَّلِهِ وَآخِرِهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillahi fi awwalihi wa akhirihi.
duas.translation: In the name of Allah at the beginning and at the end.
duas.source: Abu Dawud & Tirmidhi
duas.virtue: If you forgot to say Bismillah at the start.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَهُمْ، وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma barik lahum fima razaqtahum, waghfir lahum warhamhum.
duas.translation: O Allah, bless them in what You have provided for them, forgive them and have mercy on them.
duas.source: Muslim
duas.virtue: Dua for the host.

duas.text_arabic: إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ طَعَاماً فَلْيَقُلْ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، فَإِنْ نَسِيَ فِي أَوَّلِهِ فَلْيَقُلْ بسمِ اللَّهِ فِي أَوَّلِهِ وَآخِرِهِ
duas.transliteration: idha akala ahadukum ta'aman falyaqul bismi allahi fa'in nasiya fi awwalihi falyaqul bsmi allahi fi awwalihi wakhirihi
