duas.translation: (When you are about to eat, you should say:(Bismil-lah.)and if you forget to say it before starting, then you should say (when you remember):In the name of Allah in it’s beginning and end.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations before eating

duas.text_arabic: مَنْ أَطْعَمَهُ اللَّهُ الطَّعَامَ فَلْيَقُلْ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَأَطْعِمْنَا خَيْراً مِنْهُ، وَمَنْ سَقَاهُ اللَّهُ لَبَناً فَلْيَقُلْ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ
duas.transliteration: man at'amahu allahu atta'ama falyaqul allahumma barik lana fihi wa'at'imna khayran minhu waman saqahu allahu labanan falyaqul allahumma barik lana fihi wazidna minhu
duas.translation: (Whomever Allah feeds, should say:(O Allah, bless it for us and feed us better than it.) and whomever Allah gives milk to drink should say:(O Allah, bless it for usand give us more of it.))
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations before eating

duas.text_arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَٰذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdulillahil-ladhi at'amani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah.
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah who fed me this and provided it for me without any might or power on my part.
duas.source: Abu Dawud & Tirmidhi
duas.virtue: Past sins are forgiven.

duas.text_arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ، غَيْرَ مَكْفِيٍّ وَلَا مُوَدَّعٍ، وَلَا مُسْتَغْنًى عَنْهُ رَبَّنَا
duas.transliteration: Alhamdulillahi hamdan kathiran tayyiban mubarakan fih, ghayra makfiyyin wa la muwadda', wa la mustaghnan 'anhu Rabbana.
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah, abundant, pure, and blessed praise. This cannot be compensated, abandoned, or dispensed with, our Lord.
duas.source: Bukhari
duas.virtue: Comprehensive praise after eating.

duas.title_english: Someone who gives you drink or offers it to you
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَطْعِمْ مَنْ أَطْعَمَنِي، وَاسْقِ مَنْ سَقَانِي
duas.transliteration: allahumma at'im man at'amani wasqi man saqani
duas.translation: O Allah, feed him who fed me, and provide with drink him who provided me with drink.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocation for someone who gives you drink or offers it to you

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ
duas.transliteration: Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar. Subhanal-ladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin, wa inna ila Rabbina lamunqalibun.
duas.translation: Allah is the Greatest (3x). Glory be to Him who has subjected this to us, and we could never have it by ourselves. And verily, to Our Lord we indeed are to return.
duas.source: Muslim
duas.virtue: Said when beginning a journey.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَٰذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَىٰ، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَىٰ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inna nas'aluka fi safarina hadhal-birra wat-taqwa, wa minal-'amali ma tarda.
duas.translation: O Allah, we ask You on this journey for righteousness and piety, and for deeds which please You.
duas.source: Muslim
duas.virtue: Part of the complete travel dua.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَٰذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma hawwin 'alayna safarana hadha watw 'anna bu'dah.
duas.translation: O Allah, make this journey easy for us and shorten its distance.
duas.source: Muslim
duas.virtue: Asking for ease in the journey.

duas.text_arabic: آيِبُونَ، تَائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ
duas.transliteration: Ayibun, ta'ibun, 'abidun, li Rabbina hamidun.
duas.translation: We are returning, repenting, worshipping, and praising our Lord.
duas.source: Muslim
duas.virtue: Said when returning from a journey.

duas.title_english: Riding in a vehicle or on an animal
duas.text_arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ للَّهِ سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي؛ فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: bismi allahi walhamdu lahi subhana alladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wama kunna lahu muqrinina wa'inna ila rabbina lamunqalibuna alhamdu lillahi alhamdu lillahi alhamdu lillahi allahu akbaru allahu akbaru allahu akbaru subhanaka allahumma inni dhalamtu nafsi faghfir li fa'innahu la yaghfiru adhdhunuba ila anta
duas.translation: (In the name of Allah and all praise is for Allah. How perfect He is, the One Who has placed this (transport) at our service and we ourselves would not have been capable of that, and to our Lord is our final destiny. All praise is for Allah, All praise is for Allah, All praise is for Allah, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest. How perfect You are, O Allah, verily I have wronged my soul, so forgive me, for surely none can forgive sins except You.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocation for riding in a vehicle or on an animal

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا البِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ، وَالْخَليفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ، وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ، وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ، وإذا رَجَعَ قَالَهُنَّ وَزَادَ فِيهِنَّ آيِبُونَ، تائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ
duas.transliteration: allahu akbaru allahu akbaru allahu akbaru subhana alladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wama kunna lahu muqrinina wa'inna ila rabbina lamunqalibuna allahumma inna nas'aluka fi safarina hadha albirra walttaqwa wamina al'amali ma tarda allahumma hawwin alayna safarana hadha watwi anna bu'dahu allahumma anta assahibu fi assafari walkhalyfahu fi al'ahli allahumma inni a'udhu bika min wa'tha'i assafari wakabahi almandhari wasu'i almunqalabi fi almali wal'ahli w'dha raja'a qalahunna wazada fihinna ayibuna ta'ibuna abiduna lirabbina hamiduna
duas.translation: (Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, How perfect He is, The One Who has placed this (transport) at our service, and we ourselves would not have been capable of that, and to our Lord is our final destiny. O Allah, we ask You for birr and taqwa in this journey of ours, and we ask You for deeds which please You. O Allah, facilitate our journey and let us cover it’s distance quickly. O Allah, You are The Companion on the journey and The Successor over the family, O Allah, I take refuge with You from the difficulties of travel, from having a change of hearts and being in a bad predicament, and I take refuge in You from an ill fated outcome with wealth and family.)(birr and taqwa: two comprehensive terms which individually, refer to all good actions and obedience i.e. performing the commanded actions and avoiding the prohibited actions. When combined together, birr refers to doing those actions which have been commanded and taqwa refers to avoiding those actions which have been prohibited.)(A successor: one who succeeds another due to the latter’s absence or death. This is the correct meaning of the word khaleefah; thus, it is incorrect to believe that Adam is the khaleefah (vicegerent, as is commonly translated) of Allah on earth because Allah is never absent, and will never die. This supplication proves the correct understanding of this term and shows that Allah succeeds us and guards whom we leave behind when we die or are absent.)(upon returning the same supplication is recited with the following addition: (We return, repent, worship and praise our Lord.))
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocation for traveling

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَظْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الأَرَضِينَ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَقْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الشَّياطِينِ وَمَا أَضْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الرِّيَاحِ وَمَا ذَرَيْنَ، أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ، وَخَيْرَ أَهْلِهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ أَهْلِهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا
duas.transliteration: allahumma rabba assamawati assab'i wama adhlalna warabba al'aradina assab'i wama aqlalna warabba ashshayatini wama adlalna warabba arriyahi wama dharayna as'aluka khayra hadhihi alqaryahi wakhayra ahliha wakhayra ma fiha wa'a'udhu bika min sharriha washarri ahliha washarri ma fiha
duas.translation: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and all that they envelop, Lord of the seven earths and all that they carry, Lord of the devils and all whom they misguide, Lord of the winds and all whom they whisk away. I ask You for the goodness of this village, the goodness of its inhabitants and for all the goodness found within it and I take refuge with You from the evil of this village, the evil of its inhabitants and from all the evil found within it.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocation for entering a town or city

duas.title_english: The traveler's invocation for the one he leaves behind
duas.text_arabic: أَسْتَوْدِعُكُمُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لاَ تَضِيعُ وَدَائِعُهُ
duas.transliteration: astawdi'ukumu allaha alladhi la tadi'u wada'i'uhu
duas.translation: I place you in the trust of Allah, whose trust is never misplaced.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — The traveler's invocation for the one he leaves behind

duas.title_english: The resident's invocations for the traveler (1)
duas.text_arabic: أَسْتَوْدِعُ اللَّهَ دِينَكَ، وَأَمَانَتَكَ، وَخَوَاتِيمَ عَمَلِكَ
duas.transliteration: astawdi'u allaha dinaka wa'amanataka wakhawatima amalika
duas.translation: I place your religion, your faithfulness and the ends of your deeds in the trust of Allah.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — The resident's invocations for the traveler

duas.title_english: The resident's invocations for the traveler (2)
duas.text_arabic: زَوَّدَكَ اللَّهُ التَّقْوَى، وَغَفَرَ ذَنْبَكَ، وَيَسَّرَ لَكَ الخَيْرَ حَيْثُ ما كُنْتَ
duas.transliteration: zawwadaka allahu attaqwa waghafara dhanbaka wayassara laka alkhayra haythu ma kunta
duas.translation: (May Allah endow you with taqwa, forgive your sins and facilitate all good for you, wherever you be.)(taqwa: a comprehensive term which refers to all good actions and obedience i.e. performing the commanded actions and avoiding the prohibited actions.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — The resident's invocations for the traveler

duas.text_arabic: سَمَّعَ سَامِعٌ بِحَمْدِ اللَّهِ، وَحُسْنِ بَلاَئِهِ عَلَيْنَا، رَبَّنَا صاحِبْنَا، وَأَفْضِلْ عَلَيْنَا، عَائِذاً بِاللَّهِ مِنَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: samma'a sami'un bihamdi allahi wahusni bala'ihi alayna rabbana sahibna wa'afdil alayna a'idhan billahi mina annari
duas.translation: May a witness, be witness to our praise of Allah for His favours and bounties upon us. Our Lord, protect us, show favour on us and deliver us from every evil. I take refuge in Allah from the fire.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — The traveler's invocation at dawn

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma sayyiban nafi'an.
duas.translation: O Allah, beneficial rain.
duas.source: Bukhari
duas.virtue: Said when it rains.

duas.text_arabic: مُطِرْنَا بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ
duas.transliteration: Mutirna bi fadlillahi wa rahmatihi.
duas.translation: We have been given rain by the grace and mercy of Allah.
duas.source: Bukhari & Muslim
duas.virtue: Said after rain has fallen.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ حَوَالَيْنَا وَلَا عَلَيْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى الْآكَامِ وَالظِّرَابِ، وَبُطُونِ الْأَوْدِيَةِ، وَمَنَابِتِ الشَّجَرِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma hawalayna wa la 'alayna, Allahumma 'alal-akami wadh-dhirab, wa butunil-awdiyah, wa manabiti-shajar.
duas.translation: O Allah, around us and not upon us. O Allah, upon the hills, mountains, valleys, and the places where trees grow.
duas.source: Bukhari
duas.virtue: When rain becomes excessive.

duas.text_arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ
duas.transliteration: Subhanal-ladhi yusabbihur-ra'du bihamdihi wal-mala'ikatu min khifatih.
duas.translation: Glory be to Him whom the thunder glorifies with His praise, and the angels in awe of Him.
duas.source: Muwatta Malik
duas.virtue: Said when hearing thunder.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا غَيْثاً مُغِيثاً مَرِيئاً مَرِيعاً، نَافِعاً غَيْرَ ضَارٍّ، عَاجِلاً غَيْرَ آجِلٍ
duas.transliteration: allahumma asqina ghaythan mughithan mari'an mari'an nafi'an ghayra darrin ajilan ghayra ajilin
duas.translation: O Allah, send upon us helpful, wholesome and healthy rain, beneficial not harmful rain, now, not later.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Some invocations for rain

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا، اللَّهُمَّ أَغِثْنَا
duas.transliteration: allahumma aghithna allahumma aghithna allahumma aghithna
duas.translation: O Allah, relieve us, O Allah, relieve us, O Allah, relieve us.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Some invocations for rain

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِ عِبَادَكَ، وَبَهَائِمَكَ، وَانْشُرْ رَحْمَتَكَ، وَأَحْيِي بَلَدَكَ الْمَيِّتَ
duas.transliteration: allahumma asqi ibadaka wabaha'imaka wanshur rahmataka wa'ahyi baladaka almayyita
duas.translation: O Allah, provide water for Your servants and Your cattle, spread out Your mercy and resurrect Your dead land.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Some invocations for rain

duas.text_arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illallahul-'Adhimul-Halim, la ilaha illallahu Rabbul-'Arshil-'Adhim, la ilaha illallahu Rabbus-samawati wa Rabbul-ardi wa Rabbul-'Arshil-Karim.
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, the Mighty, the Forbearing. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.
duas.source: Bukhari & Muslim
duas.virtue: Dua said during distress.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa dala'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijal.
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, weakness and laziness, miserliness and cowardice, the burden of debts and being overpowered by men.
duas.source: Bukhari
duas.virtue: Comprehensive dua for relief from anxiety.

duas.text_arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu minadh-dhalimin.
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except You; glory be to You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
duas.source: Quran 21:87
duas.virtue: The dua of Prophet Yunus (Jonah).

duas.text_arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
duas.transliteration: Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal wakil.
duas.translation: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the Best Disposer of affairs.
duas.source: Quran 3:173
duas.virtue: Said by Ibrahim when thrown into fire, and by the Prophet.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا، وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma la sahla illa ma ja'altahu sahla, wa anta taj'alul-hazna idha shi'ta sahla.
duas.translation: O Allah, there is nothing easy except what You make easy, and You can make grief easy if You wish.
duas.source: Ibn Hibban
duas.virtue: For difficult matters.

duas.title_arabic: يا حي يا قيوم برحمتك أستغيث
duas.text_arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ
duas.transliteration: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyumu birahmatika astaghith.
duas.translation: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer of all, by Your mercy I seek relief.
duas.source: Tirmidhi, Al-Hakim
duas.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ would say this in times of distress.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو، فَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma rahmataka arju, fala takilni ila nafsi tarfata 'ayn, wa aslih li sha'ni kullah, la ilaha illa anta.
duas.translation: O Allah, I hope for Your mercy, so do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye, and rectify all of my affairs. None has the right to be worshipped except You.
duas.source: Abu Dawud
duas.virtue: A supplication for relief at times of worry.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي عَبْدُكَ، ابْنُ عَبْدِكَ، ابْنُ أَمَتِكَ، نَاصِيَتِي بِيَدِكَ، مَاضٍ فِيَّ حُكْمُكَ، عَدْلٌ فِيَّ قَضَاؤُكَ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِكُ لِّ اسْمٍ هُوَ لَكَ، سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ، أَوْ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ، أَوْ عَلَّمْتَهُ أَحَداً مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، أَوِ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ، أَنْ تَجْعَلَ القُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي، وَنُورَ صَدْرِي، وَجَلاَءَ حُزْنِي، وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي
duas.transliteration: allahumma inni abduka abnu abdika abnu amatika nasiyati biyadika madin fiyya hukmuka adlun fiyya qada'uka as'aluka biku li asmin huwa laka sammayta bihi nafsaka aw anzaltahu fi kitabika aw allamtahu ahadan min khalqika awi asta'tharta bihi fi ilmi alghaybi indaka an taj'ala alqurana rabi'a qalbi wanura sadri wajala'a huzni wadhahaba hammi
duas.translation: (O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your maidservant, my forelock is in Your hand (i.e. You have total mastery over), Your command over me is forever executed and Your decree over me is just. I ask You by every name belonging to You which You named Yourself with, or revealed in Your Book, or You taught to any of Your creation, or You have preserved in the knowledge of the unseen with You, that You make the Quran the life of my heart and the light of my breast, and a departure for my sorrow and a release for my anxiety.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations in times of worry and grief

duas.text_arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ
duas.transliteration: la ilaha ila allahu al'adhimu alhalimu la ilaha ila allahu rabbu al'arshi al'adhimi la ilaha ila allahu rabbu assamawati warabbu al'ardi warabbu al'arshi alkarimi
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah Forbearing. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the magnificent throne. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, Lord of the heavens, Lord of the Earth and Lord of the noble throne.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations for anguish

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُ اللَّهُ رَبِّي لاَ أُشْرِكُ بِهِ شَيْئاً
duas.transliteration: allahu allahu rabbi la ushriku bihi shay'an
duas.translation: Allah, Allah is my Lord, I do not associate anything with Him.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations for anguish

duas.text_arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ
duas.transliteration: la ilaha ila allahu
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What to say when you feel frightened

duas.text_arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيَّ الْقَيُّومَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
duas.transliteration: Astaghfirullaha alladhi la ilaha illa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyum wa atubu ilayhi.
duas.translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah, there is no god but He, the Living, the Self-Sustaining, and I repent to Him.
duas.source: Abu Dawud & Tirmidhi
duas.virtue: Forgiven even if he fled from the battlefield.

duas.text_arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
duas.transliteration: Astaghfirullaha wa atubu ilayhi.
duas.translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah and I repent to Him.
duas.source: Bukhari & Muslim
duas.virtue: The Prophet sought forgiveness more than 70 times a day.

duas.text_arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi-ghfir li wa tub 'alayya innaka antat-Tawwabur-Rahim.
duas.translation: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance. Indeed, You are the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful.
duas.source: Abu Dawud & Tirmidhi
duas.virtue: Said frequently by the Prophet.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ، دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ، وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ، وَعَلَانِيَتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma-ghfir li dhanbi kullahu, diqqahu wa jillahu, wa awwalahu wa akhirahu, wa 'alaniyatahu wa sirrahu.
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive all my sins, the minor and the major, the first and the last, the open and the secret.
duas.source: Muslim
duas.virtue: Comprehensive forgiveness.

duas.text_arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنْفُسَنَا وَإِنْ لَمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana zalamna anfusana wa il lam taghfir lana wa tarhamna lanakunanna minal-khasirin.
duas.translation: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.
duas.source: Quran 7:23
duas.virtue: The supplication by which Adam and Hawwa turned to Allah in repentance.

duas.text_arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
duas.transliteration: Astaghfirullahal-'Adhim alladhi la ilaha illa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyumu wa atubu ilayh.
duas.translation: I seek the forgiveness of Allah the Magnificent, whom none has the right to be worshipped except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer, and I repent to Him.
duas.source: Abu Dawud, Tirmidhi
duas.virtue: Whoever says it, Allah forgives him even if he had fled from battle.

duas.text_arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillah.
duas.translation: In the name of Allah.
duas.source: Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah
duas.virtue: There is no ablution for the one who does not mention Allah's name over it.

duas.text_arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ، اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ، وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Ashhadu an la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, wa ashhadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasuluh. Allahumma-j'alni minat-tawwabin, waj'alni minal-mutatahhirin.
duas.translation: I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. O Allah, make me of those who turn to You in repentance and make me of those who purify themselves.
duas.source: Muslim, Tirmidhi
duas.virtue: The eight gates of Paradise are opened for whoever says this after ablution, to enter by whichever he wishes.

duas.text_arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
duas.transliteration: ashhadu an la ilaha ila allahu wahdahu la sharika lahu wa'ashhadu anna muhammadan abduhu warasuluhu
duas.translation: I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone without partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What to say upon completing ablution

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
duas.transliteration: allahumma aj'alni mina attawwabina waj'alni mina almutatahhirina
duas.translation: O Allah, make me of those who return to You often in repentance and make me of those who remain clean and pure.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What to say upon completing ablution

duas.text_arabic: سُبْحانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتوبُ إِلَيْكَ
duas.transliteration: subhanaka allahumma wabihamdika ashhadu an la ilaha ila anta astaghfiruka wa'atwbu ilayka
duas.translation: How perfect You are O Allah, and I praise You, I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You, I seek Your forgiveness and turn in repentance to You.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What to say upon completing ablution

duas.text_arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillah, Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-khubuthi wal-khaba'ith.
duas.translation: In the name of Allah. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the male and female devils.
duas.source: Bukhari & Muslim
duas.virtue: A screen between the eyes of the jinn and the private parts of the children of Adam.

duas.text_arabic: غُفْرَانَكَ
duas.transliteration: Ghufranak.
duas.translation: I seek Your forgiveness.
duas.source: Abu Dawud, Tirmidhi, Ibn Majah
duas.virtue: Said by the Prophet ﷺ upon leaving the toilet.

duas.text_arabic: يُرَدِّدُ مِثْلَ مَا يَقُولُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ، إِلَّا فِي الْحَيْعَلَتَيْنِ فَيَقُولُ: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Repeat what the muezzin says, except at 'Hayya 'alas-salah' and 'Hayya 'alal-falah', where you say: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.
duas.translation: Repeat after the muezzin word for word; but when he says 'Come to prayer' and 'Come to success', say: 'There is no might nor power except with Allah.'
duas.source: Bukhari & Muslim
duas.virtue: Whoever repeats after the muezzin from his heart enters Paradise.

duas.text_arabic: وَأَنَا أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ، رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولًا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا
duas.transliteration: Wa ana ashhadu an la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, wa anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasuluh, raditu billahi Rabba, wa bi-Muhammadin rasula, wa bil-Islami dina.
duas.translation: And I too bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner, and that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Muhammad as Messenger, and with Islam as my religion.
duas.source: Muslim
duas.virtue: Whoever says this upon hearing the testimony in the adhan, his sins are forgiven.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَٰذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ، وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ، آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma Rabba hadhihid-da'watit-tammah, wassalatil-qa'imah, ati Muhammadanil-wasilata wal-fadilah, wab'athhu maqaman mahmudanil-ladhi wa'adtah.
duas.translation: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and established prayer, grant Muhammad the intercession and favor, and raise him to the praised station which You have promised him.
duas.source: Bukhari
duas.virtue: Whoever says this after the adhan, the Prophet's intercession becomes due for him on the Day of Resurrection.

duas.text_arabic: يَقُولُ وَأَنَا أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ، رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبَّاً، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولاً، وَبِالْإِسْلاَمِ دِينَاً يَقُولُ ذَلِكَ عَقِبَ تَشَهُّدِ الْمُؤَذِّنِ
duas.transliteration: yaqulu wa'ana ashhadu an la ilaha ila allahu wahdahu la sharika lahu wa'anna muhammadan abduhu warasuluhu raditu billahi rabban wabimuhammadin rasulan wabial'islami dinan yaqulu dhalika aqiba tashahhudi almu'adhdhini
duas.translation: Immediately following the declaration of faith called by the mu-aththin, one says:‘And I too bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, and that Muhammad is His salve and Messenger. I am pleased with Allah as a Lord, and Muhammad as a Messenger and Islam as a religion.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What to say upon hearing the Athan (call to prayer)

duas.text_arabic: يَقُولُ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ، وَالصَّلاَةِ الْقَائِمَةِ، آتِ مُحَمَّداً الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامَاً مَحمُوداً الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ، إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
duas.transliteration: yaqulu allahumma rabba hadhihi adda'wahi attammahi walssalahi alqa'imahi ati muhammadan alwasilaha walfadilaha wab'athhu maqaman mahmudan alladhi wa'adtahu innaka la tukhlifu almi'ada
duas.translation: O Allah, Owner of this perfect call and Owner of this prayer to be performed, bestow upon Muhammad al-waseelah and al-fadeelah and send him upon a praised platform which You have promised him. Verily, You never fail in Your promise.’al-waseelah: A station in paradise.al-fadeelah: A rank above the rest of creation.praised platform: One in which all of creation will praise him on, in order to bring about the account quickly and be relieved from the lengthy standing or the role of intercession.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What to say upon hearing the Athan (call to prayer)

duas.text_arabic: يَدْعُو لِنَفسِهِ بَيْنَ الْأَذَانِ وَالْإِقَامَةِ فَإِنَّ الدُّعَاءَ حِينَئِذٍ لاَ يُرَدُّ
duas.transliteration: yad'u linafsihi bayna al'adhani wal'iqamahi fa'inna addu'a'a hina'idhin la yuraddu
duas.translation: One should also supplicate for himself during the time between the athan and the iqamah as supplication at such time is not rejected.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What to say upon hearing the Athan (call to prayer)

duas.text_arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَٰذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلَا قُوَّةٍ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdulillahil-ladhi kasani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah.
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah who has clothed me with this and provided it for me without any might or power on my part.
duas.source: Abu Dawud, Tirmidhi, Ibn Majah
duas.virtue: Whoever says this when wearing a garment, his past sins are forgiven.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيهِ، أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهِ وَخَيْرِ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma lakal-hamdu anta kasawtanih, as'aluka min khayrihi wa khayri ma suni'a lah, wa a'udhu bika min sharrihi wa sharri ma suni'a lah.
duas.translation: O Allah, all praise is for You; You have clothed me with it. I ask You for its good and the good for which it was made, and I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil for which it was made.
duas.source: Abu Dawud, Tirmidhi
duas.virtue: Said when putting on a new garment.

duas.text_arabic: الْحَمْدُ للَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا الثَّوْبَ وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّة
duas.transliteration: alhamdu lahi alladhi kasani hadha aththawba warazaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wala quwwah
duas.translation: All Praise is for Allah who has clothed me with this garment and provided it for me, with no power nor might from myself.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocation when getting dressed

duas.title_english: Someone who has put on new clothes (1)
duas.text_arabic: تُبْلِي وَيُخْلِفُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى
duas.transliteration: tubli wayukhlifu allahu ta'ala
duas.translation: (May you wear it out and Allah تعالى replace it (with another).’ The intended meaning: A supplication for long life.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations for someone who has put on new clothes

duas.title_english: Someone who has put on new clothes (2)
duas.text_arabic: اِلْبَسْ جَدِيداً وَعِشْ حَمِيداً وَمُتْ شَهِيداً
duas.transliteration: ailbas jadidan wa'ish hamidan wamut shahidan
duas.translation: (Wear anew, live commendably and die a shaheed.)(shaheed:One who dies fighting the kuffar in order to make the word of Allah superior or in defense of Islam. It also has other meanings found in the Sunnah such as: the one who dies defending his life, wealth or family; the woman who passes away due to childbirth; one who drowns…etc.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations for someone who has put on new clothes

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ، وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلَا أَقْدِرُ، وَتَعْلَمُ وَلَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَٰذَا الْأَمْرَ خَيْرٌ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاقْدُرْهُ لِي وَيَسِّرْهُ لِي ثُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِيهِ، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّ هَٰذَا الْأَمْرَ شَرٌّ لِي فِي دِينِي وَمَعَاشِي وَعَاقِبَةِ أَمْرِي فَاصْرِفْهُ عَنِّي وَاصْرِفْنِي عَنْهُ، وَاقْدُرْ لِيَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُ كَانَ ثُمَّ أَرْضِنِي بِهِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni astakhiruka bi'ilmik, wa astaqdiruka biqudratik, wa as'aluka min fadlikal-'adhim, fa innaka taqdiru wa la aqdir, wa ta'lamu wa la a'lam, wa anta 'allamul-ghuyub. Allahumma in kunta ta'lamu anna hadhal-amra khayrun li fi dini wa ma'ashi wa 'aqibati amri faqdurhu li wa yassirhu li thumma barik li fih, wa in kunta ta'lamu anna hadhal-amra sharrun li fi dini wa ma'ashi wa 'aqibati amri fasrifhu 'anni wasrifni 'anhu, waqdur liyal-khayra haythu kana thumma ardini bih.
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek Your guidance by Your knowledge, and I seek ability by Your power, and I ask You of Your great bounty. You have power, I have none; You know, I know not; You are the Knower of the unseen. O Allah, if You know that this matter is good for me in my religion, my livelihood and the outcome of my affairs, then decree it for me, make it easy for me, and bless it for me. And if You know that this matter is bad for me in my religion, my livelihood and the outcome of my affairs, then turn it away from me and turn me away from it, and decree for me what is good wherever it may be, and make me content with it.
duas.source: Bukhari
duas.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ taught Istikharah for all matters as he taught a chapter of the Qur'an; mention your need where the dua refers to 'this matter'.

duas.text_arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdulillah.
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah.
duas.source: Bukhari
duas.virtue: When one sneezes he should praise Allah, and his Muslim brother should respond.

duas.title_english: Response of the One Who Sneezed
duas.text_arabic: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ
duas.transliteration: Yahdikumullahu wa yuslihu balakum.
duas.translation: May Allah guide you and rectify your affairs.
duas.source: Bukhari
duas.virtue: When the one who sneezed praises Allah and is told 'YarhamukAllah' (may Allah have mercy on you), he replies with this.

duas.text_arabic: إِذَا عَطَسَ أَحَدُكُم فَلْيَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلْيَقُلْ لَهُ أَخُوهُ أَوْ صَاحِبُهُ يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ، فَإِذَا قَالَ لَهُ يَرحَمُكَ اللَّهُ، فَلْيَقُلْ يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ
duas.transliteration: idha atasa ahadukum falyaquli alhamdu lillahi walyaqul lahu akhuhu aw sahibuhu yarhamuka allahu fa'idha qala lahu yarhamuka allahu falyaqul yahdikumu allahu wayuslihu balakum
duas.translation: (When one of you sneezes he should say:(All praise if for Allah.) and his brother or companion should say to him: (May Allah have mercy upon you.) and he (i.e. the one who sneezed) replies back to him:(May Allah guide you and rectify your condition.))
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocation for sneezing

duas.text_arabic: رَبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbi zidni 'ilma.
duas.translation: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
duas.source: Quran 20:114
duas.virtue: A concise Qur'anic supplication for beneficial knowledge.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ انْفَعْنِي بِمَا عَلَّمْتَنِي، وَعَلِّمْنِي مَا يَنْفَعُنِي، وَزِدْنِي عِلْمًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma-nfa'ni bima 'allamtani, wa 'allimni ma yanfa'uni, wa zidni 'ilma.
duas.translation: O Allah, benefit me by what You have taught me, teach me what will benefit me, and increase me in knowledge.
duas.source: Tirmidhi, Ibn Majah
duas.virtue: A supplication of the Prophet ﷺ for beneficial knowledge.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا، وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman nafi'an, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa 'amalan mutaqabbala.
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and deeds that are accepted.
duas.source: Ibn Majah
duas.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ would say this after the Fajr prayer.

duas.text_arabic: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ
duas.transliteration: Ya muqallibal-qulubi thabbit qalbi 'ala dinik.
duas.translation: O Turner of the hearts, keep my heart firm upon Your religion.
duas.source: Tirmidhi
duas.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ frequently supplicated with these words.

duas.title_arabic: رب إني لما أنزلت إلي من خير فقير
duas.text_arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنْزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi inni lima anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqir.
duas.translation: My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need.
duas.source: Quran 28:24
duas.virtue: The supplication of Musa عليه السلام when he was in need.

duas.title_arabic: ربنا أنزل علينا مائدة من السماء
duas.text_arabic: رَبَّنَا أَنْزِلْ عَلَيْنَا مَائِدَةً مِنَ السَّمَاءِ تَكُونُ لَنَا عِيدًا لِأَوَّلِنَا وَآخِرِنَا وَآيَةً مِنْكَ، وَارْزُقْنَا وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana anzil 'alayna ma'idatan minas-sama'i takunu lana 'idan li'awwalina wa akhirina wa ayatan mink, warzuqna wa anta khayrur-raziqin.
duas.translation: Our Lord, send down to us a table spread with food from the heaven to be for us a festival for the first of us and the last of us and a sign from You. And provide for us, for You are the best of providers.
duas.source: Quran 5:114
duas.virtue: The supplication of Isa عليه السلام asking Allah for provision.

duas.title_english: Placing the Hand on the Pain
duas.title_arabic: دعاء وضع اليد على موضع الألم
duas.text_arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ (ثَلَاثًا) أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ (سَبْعًا)
duas.transliteration: Bismillah (three times). A'udhu billahi wa qudratihi min sharri ma ajidu wa uhadhir (seven times).
duas.translation: In the name of Allah (three times). I seek refuge in Allah and His power from the evil of what I feel and fear (seven times).
duas.source: Muslim
duas.virtue: Place the hand on the place of pain and say it; it removes the ailment.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ، اشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma Rabban-nas, adhhibil-ba's, ishfi antash-Shafi, la shifa'a illa shifa'uk, shifa'an la yughadiru saqama.
duas.translation: O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove the harm and heal; You are the Healer. There is no healing except Your healing, a healing that leaves behind no ailment.
duas.source: Bukhari & Muslim
duas.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ used this to seek healing for the sick.

duas.text_arabic: لَا بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
duas.transliteration: La ba'sa tahurun in sha'Allah.
duas.translation: No harm, it is a purification, Allah willing.
duas.source: Bukhari
duas.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ would say this when visiting a sick person.

duas.title_english: Asking Allah Seven Times for Healing
duas.text_arabic: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ
duas.transliteration: As'alullahal-'Adhima Rabbal-'Arshil-'Adhimi an yashfiyak.
duas.translation: I ask Allah the Magnificent, Lord of the Magnificent Throne, to heal you.
duas.source: Abu Dawud, Tirmidhi
duas.virtue: Whoever visits a sick person whose time has not come and says this seven times, Allah will cure him of that illness.

duas.text_arabic: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفيَكَ سبع مرات
duas.transliteration: as'alu allaha al'adhyma rabba al'arshi al'adhimi an yashfyaka sb mrat
duas.translation: (I ask Allah The Supreme, Lord of the magnificent throne to cure you’.(7times) (he (the sick person) will be cured.))
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations for visiting the sick

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالرَّفِيقِ الْأَعْلَى
duas.transliteration: allahumma aghfir li warhamni wa'alhiqni bialrrafiqi al'a'la
duas.translation: O Allaah, forgive me, have mercy upon me and unite me with the highest companions
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations of the terminal ill

duas.text_arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ لَهُ المُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: la ilaha ila allahu wallahu akbaru la ilaha ila allahu wahdahu la ilaha ila allahu wahdahu la sharika lahu la ilaha ila allahu lahu almulku walahu alhamdu la ilaha ila allahu wala hawla wala quwwaha ila billahi
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and Allah is the greatest.None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone.None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner.None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah and there is no might and no power except with Allah.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations of the terminal ill

duas.title_english: You feel a pain in your body
duas.text_arabic: ضَعْ يَدَكَ عَلَى الَّذِي تَألَّمَ مِنْ جَسَدِكَ وَقُلْ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، ثَلاَثاً، وَقُلْ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ
duas.transliteration: da yadaka ala alladhi ta'llama min jasadika waqul bismi allahi thalathan waqul sab'a marratin a'udhu billahi waqudratihi min sharri ma ajidu wa'uhadhiru
duas.translation: (Place your hand at the site of the pain and say: (In the name of Allah(three times)) the supplicate seven times: (I take refuge in Allah and within His omnipotence from the evil that I feel and am wary of.))
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What to say when you feel a pain in your body

duas.text_arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي، وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
duas.transliteration: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un. Allahumma'-jurni fi musibati, wa akhlif li khayran minha.
duas.translation: Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we shall return. O Allah, reward me for my affliction and give me something better than it in its place.
duas.source: Muslim
duas.virtue: Whoever says this when afflicted, Allah rewards him and replaces his loss with something better.

duas.title_arabic: اللهم لا سهل إلا ما جعلته سهلا
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا، وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma la sahla illa ma ja'altahu sahla, wa anta taj'alul-hazna idha shi'ta sahla.
duas.translation: O Allah, there is no ease except in what You make easy, and You make the difficult, if You will, easy.
duas.source: Ibn Hibban
duas.virtue: Said when facing a hard matter so that Allah makes it easy.

duas.title_english: Something you dislike happens, or for when you fail to achieve what you attempt to do
duas.text_arabic: قَدَرُ اللَّهُ وَمَا شَاءَ فَعَلَ
duas.transliteration: qadaru allahu wama sha'a fa'ala
duas.translation: (Allah has decreed and what He wills, He does.)(for verily ‘If’ lets in the work of the devil.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocation for when something you dislike happens, or for when you fail to achieve what you attempt to do

duas.text_arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
duas.transliteration: A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajim.
duas.translation: I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed devil.
duas.source: Bukhari & Muslim
duas.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ said that whoever says this when angry, his anger will leave him.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma-kfini bihalalika 'an haramik, wa aghnini bifadlika 'amman siwak.
duas.translation: O Allah, suffice me with what You have made lawful instead of what You have made unlawful, and make me independent of all others besides You by Your bounty.
duas.source: Tirmidhi
duas.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ taught this to relieve a debt as great as a mountain.

duas.title_arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من المأثم والمغرم
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْمَأْثَمِ وَالْمَغْرَمِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-ma'thami wal-maghram.
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from sin and from being in debt.
duas.source: Bukhari & Muslim
duas.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ would seek refuge from debt, for one in debt may lie and break promises.

duas.title_english: (upon receipt of the loan) for someone who lends you money
duas.text_arabic: بارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ، إِنَّمَا جَزَاءُ السَّلَفِ الْحَمْدُ وَالأَدَاءُ
duas.transliteration: baraka allahu laka fi ahlika wamalika innama jaza'u assalafi alhamdu wal'ada'u
duas.translation: May Allah bless for you, your family and wealth. Surely commendation and payment are the reward for a loan.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocation (upon receipt of the loan) for someone who lends you money

duas.text_arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaban-nar.
duas.translation: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
duas.source: Quran 2:201
duas.virtue: The supplication the Prophet ﷺ made most often.

duas.text_arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِنْ نَسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا، رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا، رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ، وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا، أَنْتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana la tu'akhidhna in nasina aw akhta'na, Rabbana wa la tahmil 'alayna isran kama hamaltahu 'alal-ladhina min qablina, Rabbana wa la tuhammilna ma la taqata lana bih, wa'fu 'anna waghfir lana warhamna, anta mawlana fansurna 'alal-qawmil-kafirin.
duas.translation: Our Lord, do not take us to task if we forget or err. Our Lord, do not lay upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, do not burden us with what we have no power to bear. Pardon us, forgive us, and have mercy on us. You are our Protector, so grant us victory over the disbelieving people.
duas.source: Quran 2:286
duas.virtue: The closing verses of Surah Al-Baqarah; whoever recites them at night, they suffice him.

duas.text_arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana la tuzigh qulubana ba'da idh hadaytana wa hab lana min ladunka rahmah, innaka antal-Wahhab.
duas.translation: Our Lord, do not let our hearts deviate after You have guided us, and grant us mercy from Yourself. Indeed, You are the Bestower.
duas.source: Quran 3:8
duas.virtue: A plea for steadfastness upon guidance.

duas.text_arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِي، رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ، رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi-j'alni muqimas-salati wa min dhurriyyati, Rabbana wa taqabbal du'a. Rabbana-ghfir li wa liwalidayya wa lil-mu'minina yawma yaqumul-hisab.
duas.translation: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and many from my descendants. Our Lord, accept my supplication. Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers on the Day the account is established.
duas.virtue: The supplication of Ibrahim عليه السلام for prayer and forgiveness.

duas.text_arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbana hab lana min azwajina wa dhurriyyatina qurrata a'yunin waj'alna lil-muttaqina imama.
duas.translation: Our Lord, grant us from among our spouses and offspring comfort to our eyes, and make us leaders for the righteous.
duas.source: Quran 25:74
duas.virtue: Among the qualities of the servants of the Most Merciful.

duas.text_arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي، وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي، وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِنْ لِسَانِي، يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
duas.transliteration: Rabbi-shrah li sadri, wa yassir li amri, wahlul 'uqdatan min lisani, yafqahu qawli.
duas.translation: My Lord, expand for me my chest, ease for me my task, and untie the knot from my tongue that they may understand my speech.
duas.virtue: The supplication of Musa عليه السلام for confidence and clarity.

duas.text_arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنْتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi-ghfir warham wa anta khayrur-rahimin.
duas.translation: My Lord, forgive and have mercy, for You are the best of the merciful.
duas.source: Quran 23:118
duas.virtue: A concise plea for Allah's forgiveness and mercy.

duas.text_arabic: رَبِّ أَدْخِلْنِي مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ وَأَخْرِجْنِي مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ وَاجْعَلْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ سُلْطَانًا نَصِيرًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbi adkhilni mudkhala sidqin wa akhrijni mukhraja sidqin waj'al li min ladunka sultanan nasira.
duas.translation: My Lord, cause me to enter a sound entrance and to exit a sound exit, and grant me from Yourself a supporting authority.
duas.source: Quran 17:80
duas.virtue: A supplication for sincerity and divine support in all affairs.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى، وَالتُّقَى، وَالْعَفَافَ، وَالْغِنَى
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-huda, wat-tuqa, wal-'afafa, wal-ghina.
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity and self-sufficiency.
duas.source: Muslim
duas.virtue: A comprehensive supplication taught by the Prophet ﷺ.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ لِي دِينِي الَّذِي هُوَ عِصْمَةُ أَمْرِي، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي دُنْيَايَ الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَاشِي، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي آخِرَتِي الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَادِي، وَاجْعَلِ الْحَيَاةَ زِيَادَةً لِي فِي كُلِّ خَيْرٍ، وَاجْعَلِ الْمَوْتَ رَاحَةً لِي مِنْ كُلِّ شَرٍّ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma aslih li dinil-ladhi huwa 'ismatu amri, wa aslih li dunyayal-lati fiha ma'ashi, wa aslih li akhiratil-lati fiha ma'adi, waj'alil-hayata ziyadatan li fi kulli khayr, waj'alil-mawta rahatan li min kulli sharr.
duas.translation: O Allah, set right for me my religion which is the safeguard of my affairs; set right for me my worldly life in which is my living; set right for me my Hereafter to which is my return; make life for me an increase in every good, and make death a relief for me from every evil.
duas.source: Muslim
duas.virtue: A complete supplication covering religion, this world and the next.

duas.title_arabic: اللهم إني أسألك من الخير كله
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ كُلِّهِ عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهُ وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الشَّرِّ كُلِّهِ عَاجِلِهِ وَآجِلِهِ مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهُ وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka minal-khayri kullihi 'ajilihi wa ajilihi ma 'alimtu minhu wa ma lam a'lam, wa a'udhu bika minash-sharri kullihi 'ajilihi wa ajilihi ma 'alimtu minhu wa ma lam a'lam.
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for all good, in this world and the next, what I know of it and what I do not; and I seek refuge in You from all evil, in this world and the next, what I know of it and what I do not.
duas.source: Ibn Majah, Ahmad
duas.virtue: An all-encompassing request for good and refuge from evil.

duas.title_english: Love of Allah and Righteous Deeds
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ فِعْلَ الْخَيْرَاتِ، وَتَرْكَ الْمُنْكَرَاتِ، وَحُبَّ الْمَسَاكِينِ، وَأَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي وَتَرْحَمَنِي، وَإِذَا أَرَدْتَ فِتْنَةً فِي قَوْمٍ فَتَوَفَّنِي غَيْرَ مَفْتُونٍ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ حُبَّكَ، وَحُبَّ مَنْ يُحِبُّكَ، وَحُبَّ عَمَلٍ يُقَرِّبُ إِلَى حُبِّكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka fi'lal-khayrat, wa tarkal-munkarat, wa hubbal-masakin, wa an taghfira li wa tarhamani, wa idha aradta fitnatan fi qawmin fatawaffani ghayra maftun, wa as'aluka hubbaka, wa hubba man yuhibbuk, wa hubba 'amalin yuqarribu ila hubbik.
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for the doing of good deeds, the avoidance of evil deeds, and love of the poor. Forgive me and have mercy on me, and when You intend a trial for a people, take me to You without being tried. I ask You for Your love, the love of those who love You, and the love of every deed that brings me closer to Your love.
duas.source: Tirmidhi (graded Sahih)
duas.virtue: From the hadith of the Prophet's dream; he commanded that it be learned and recited.

duas.title_english: Refuge from the Removal of Blessings
duas.title_arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من زوال نعمتك
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ، وَتَحَوُّلِ عَافِيَتِكَ، وَفُجَاءَةِ نِقْمَتِكَ، وَجَمِيعِ سَخَطِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min zawali ni'matik, wa tahawwuli 'afiyatik, wa fuja'ati niqmatik, wa jami'i sakhatik.
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the removal of Your blessing, the change of the wellbeing You have granted, the suddenness of Your retribution, and from all that angers You.
duas.source: Muslim
duas.virtue: Seeking protection for the continuation of Allah's favours.

duas.title_arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من علم لا ينفع
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ لَا يَنْفَعُ، وَمِنْ قَلْبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ، وَمِنْ نَفْسٍ لَا تَشْبَعُ، وَمِنْ دَعْوَةٍ لَا يُسْتَجَابُ لَهَا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min 'ilmin la yanfa', wa min qalbin la yakhsha', wa min nafsin la tashba', wa min da'watin la yustajabu laha.
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from knowledge that does not benefit, a heart that does not humble itself, a soul that is never satisfied, and a supplication that is not answered.
duas.source: Muslim
duas.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ regularly sought refuge with these words.

duas.text_arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ، وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
duas.transliteration: Barakallahu lak, wa baraka 'alayk, wa jama'a baynakuma fi khayr.
duas.translation: May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and join you both together in goodness.
duas.source: Abu Dawud, Tirmidhi
duas.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ would say this to congratulate someone on marriage.

duas.text_arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ، وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا
duas.transliteration: Bismillah, Allahumma jannibnash-shaytan, wa jannibish-shaytana ma razaqtana.
duas.translation: In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep Satan away from us, and keep Satan away from what You provide us.
duas.source: Bukhari & Muslim
duas.virtue: If a child is decreed between them, Satan will never harm it.

duas.text_arabic: أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ، مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
duas.transliteration: U'idhukuma bikalimatillahit-tammah, min kulli shaytanin wa hammah, wa min kulli 'aynin lammah.
duas.translation: I seek protection for you both in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and every poisonous creature, and from every evil, envious eye.
duas.source: Bukhari
duas.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ would seek refuge for Hasan and Husayn with these words.

duas.title_arabic: رب هب لي من لدنك ذرية طيبة
duas.text_arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً، إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi hab li min ladunka dhurriyyatan tayyibah, innaka Sami'ud-du'a.
duas.translation: My Lord, grant me from Yourself good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication.
duas.source: Quran 3:38
duas.virtue: The supplication of Zakariyya عليه السلام for righteous children.

duas.title_english: Congratulations for new parents and how they should respond
duas.text_arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي الْمَوْهُوبِ لَكَ، وَشَكَرْتَ الْوَاهِبَ، وَبَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ، وَرُزِقْتَ بِرَّهُ وَيَرُدُّ عَلَيْهِ الْمُهَ نَّأُ فَيَقُولُ بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْراً، وَرَزَقَكَ اللَّهُ مِثْلَهُ، وَأَجْزَلَ ثَوَابَكَ
duas.transliteration: baraka allahu laka fi almawhubi laka washakarta alwahiba wabalagha ashuddahu waruziqta birrahu wayaruddu alayhi almuha na'u fayaqulu baraka allahu laka wabaraka alayka wajazaka allahu khayran warazaqaka allahu mithlahu wa'ajzala thawabaka
duas.translation: May Allah bless you with His gift to you and may you (the new parent) give thanks, may the child reach the maturity of years, and may you be granted its righteousness. The reply of the person being congratulated is to say: May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and may Allah reward you well and bestow upon you its like and reward you abundantly
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Congratulations for new parents and how they should respond

duas.title_english: The groom’s supplication on the wedding night or when buying an animal
duas.text_arabic: إِذَا تَزَوَّجَ أَحَدُكُمُ امْرَأَةً، أَوْ إِذَا اشْتَرَى خَادِماً فَلْيَقُلْ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَإِذَا اشْتَرَى بَعِيراً فَلْيَأْخُذْ بِذِرْوَةِ سَنَامِهِ وَلْيَقُلْ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ
duas.transliteration: idha tazawwaja ahadukumu amra'ahan aw idha ashtara khadiman falyaqul allahumma inni as'aluka khayraha wakhayra ma jabaltaha alayhi wa'a'udhu bika min sharriha washarri ma jabaltaha alayhi wa'idha ashtara ba'iran falya'khudh bidhirwahi sanamihi walyaqul mithla dhalika
duas.translation: (when you marry a woman or buy a maidservant, you should say:(O Allah, I ask You for the goodness within her and the goodness that you have made her inclined towards, and I take refuge with You from the evil within her and the evil that you have made her inclined towards.))(and if you buy a camel, then you should take hold of it’s hump and say likewise.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — The groom’s supplication on the wedding night or when buying an animal

duas.text_arabic: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
duas.transliteration: Labbayka Allahumma labbayk, labbayka la sharika laka labbayk, innal-hamda wan-ni'mata laka wal-mulk, la sharika lak.
duas.translation: Here I am, O Allah, here I am. Here I am, You have no partner, here I am. Indeed all praise, grace and sovereignty belong to You. You have no partner.
duas.source: Bukhari & Muslim
duas.virtue: The call of the pilgrim during Hajj and Umrah until the stoning of Jamratul-'Aqabah.

duas.text_arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa Huwa 'ala kulli shay'in Qadir.
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He is over all things competent.
duas.source: Tirmidhi
duas.virtue: The best supplication is that of the Day of Arafah, and the best that the Prophets and he said was this.

duas.text_arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaban-nar.
duas.translation: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
duas.source: Abu Dawud
duas.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ would recite this between the Yemeni corner and the Black Stone during Tawaf.

duas.title_english: Saying Allahu Akbar while stoning the three pillars at Mina
duas.text_arabic: يُكَبِّرُ كُلَّمَا رَمَى بِحَصَاةٍ عِنْدَ الْجِمَارِ الثَّلاَثِ، ثُمَّ يَتَقَدَّمُ، ويَقِفُ يَدْعُو مُسْتَقْبِلَ الْقِبلَةِ، رَافِعاً يَدَيْهِ بَعْدَ الْجَمْرَةِ الْأُولَى وَالثَّانِيَةِ أَمَّا جَمْرَةُ الْعَقَبَةِ فَيَرْمِيهَا وَيُكَبِّرُ عِنْدَ كُلِّ حَصَاةٍ وَيَنْصَرِفُ وَلاَ يَقِفُ عِنْدَهَا
duas.transliteration: yukabbiru kullama rama bihasahin inda aljimari aththalathi thumma yataqaddamu wyaqifu yad'u mustaqbila alqiblahi rafi'an yadayhi ba'da aljamrahi al'ula walththaniyahi amma jamrahu al'aqabahi fayarmiha wayukabbiru inda kulli hasahin wayansarifu wala yaqifu indaha
duas.translation: The Prophet PBUH said Allaahu 'Akbar (Allah is the Most Great) with each pebble he threw at the three pillars. Then he went forward, stood facing the Qiblah and raised his hands and called upon Allah. That was after (stoning) the first and second pillar As for the third, he stoned it and called out Allahu Akbar with every pebble he threw but when he was finished he left without standing at it (for supplications).
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Saying Allahu Akbar while stoning the three pillars at Mina

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma salli 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammad, kama sallayta 'ala Ibrahima wa 'ala ali Ibrahim, innaka Hamidun Majid. Allahumma barik 'ala Muhammadin wa 'ala ali Muhammad, kama barakta 'ala Ibrahima wa 'ala ali Ibrahim, innaka Hamidun Majid.
duas.translation: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You sent prayers upon Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim; You are indeed Praiseworthy, Glorious. O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim; You are indeed Praiseworthy, Glorious.
duas.source: Bukhari & Muslim
duas.virtue: The complete salawat the Prophet ﷺ taught when asked how to send prayers upon him.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma salli wa sallim 'ala nabiyyina Muhammad.
duas.translation: O Allah, send prayers and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.
duas.source: Muslim
duas.virtue: Whoever sends one prayer upon the Prophet ﷺ, Allah sends ten upon him.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ جَهْدِ الْبَلَاءِ، وَدَرَكِ الشَّقَاءِ، وَسُوءِ الْقَضَاءِ، وَشَمَاتَةِ الْأَعْدَاءِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min jahdil-bala', wa darakish-shaqa', wa su'il-qada', wa shamatatil-a'da'.
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardship of affliction, from being overtaken by wretchedness, from an evil decree, and from the gloating of enemies.
duas.source: Bukhari & Muslim
duas.virtue: The Prophet ﷺ would seek refuge from these four things.

duas.title_arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من منكرات الأخلاق
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ مُنْكَرَاتِ الْأَخْلَاقِ، وَالْأَعْمَالِ، وَالْأَهْوَاءِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min munkaratil-akhlaq, wal-a'mal, wal-ahwa'.
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from evil character, evil deeds, and evil desires.
duas.source: Tirmidhi
duas.virtue: A supplication seeking protection from all forms of corruption of the self.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma 'afini fi badani, Allahumma 'afini fi sam'i, Allahumma 'afini fi basari, la ilaha illa anta.
duas.translation: O Allah, grant me wellbeing in my body. O Allah, grant me wellbeing in my hearing. O Allah, grant me wellbeing in my sight. None has the right to be worshipped except You.
duas.source: Abu Dawud
duas.virtue: Said three times morning and evening, seeking health and protection.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْفَقْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-kufri wal-faqr, wa a'udhu bika min 'adhabil-qabr, la ilaha illa anta.
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty, and I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave. None has the right to be worshipped except You.
duas.source: Abu Dawud, An-Nasai
duas.virtue: Said morning and evening for protection of one's faith and condition.

duas.title_english: If you are stricken by in your faith (1)
duas.text_arabic: يَقُولُ آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ
duas.transliteration: yaqulu amantu billahi warusulihi
duas.translation: (He should say: (I have believed in Allah and His Messenger.))
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations for if you are stricken by in your faith

duas.title_english: If you are stricken by in your faith (2)
duas.text_arabic: يَقْرَأُ قَوْلَهُ تَعَالَى هُوَ الْأوَّلُ وَالْآخِرُ وَالظّاهِرُ وَالْباطِنُ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
duas.transliteration: yaqra'u qawlahu ta'ala huwa al'wwalu walakhiru waldhdhahiru walbatinu wahuwa bikulli shay'in alimun
duas.translation: (He should also recite the following verse: (He is The First and The Last, Aththahir and Al-Batin and He knows well all things.)(ththahir: Indicates the greatness of His attributes and the insignificance of every single creation in respect to His greatness and Highness, for He is above all of His creation as regards His essence and attributes.)(Al-Batin: Indicates His awareness and knowledge of all secrets, of that which is in the hearts and the most intimate of things just as it indicates His closeness and nearness to all in a manner which befits His majesty.))
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations for if you are stricken by in your faith

duas.text_arabic: الْاسْتِعَاذَةُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْهُ
duas.transliteration: alasti'adhahu billahi minhu
duas.translation: Seeking refuge from him.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations against the Devil and his promptings

duas.text_arabic: الْأَذَانُ
duas.transliteration: al'adhanu
duas.translation: The Adhaan [call to prayer].
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations against the Devil and his promptings

duas.text_arabic: الْأَذْكَارُ وَقِرَاءَةُ الْقُرْآنِ
duas.transliteration: al'adhkaru waqira'ahu alqurani
duas.translation: (Recitation of the Quran and the authentic texts of remembrance and supplications.)(e.g. ‘Do not make your homes like the graveyards, indeed the devils flee from the house in which soorat Al-Baqarah has been read’ related by Muslim 1/539, also supplication and remembrance for the morning & evening, before sleep, when getting up, entering and leaving the toilet, entering and leaving the mosque, the recitation of ayat Al-kursiyy and the last two verses of soorat Al-Baqarah before sleeping, the athan…etc.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations against the Devil and his promptings

duas.title_english: Allah's protection from the False Messiah
duas.text_arabic: مَنْ حَفِظَ عَشْرَ آيَاتٍ مِنْ أَوَّلِ سُورَةِ الْكَهْفِ عُصِمَ مِنَ الدَّجَّالِ، وَالْاسْتِعَاذَةُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ فِتْنَتِهِ عَقِبَ التَّشَهُّدِ الْأَخِيرِ مِنْ كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ
duas.transliteration: man hafidha ashra ayatin min awwali surahi alkahfi usima mina addajjali walasti'adhahu billahi min fitnatihi aqiba attashahhudi al'akhiri min kulli salahin
duas.translation: (Dajjal: among the great signs of the last hour and the greatest trials to befall mankind, which every Prophet has warned about. Most of mankind will folow him. He will appear from Asbahan, Iran at the time when Muslims will conquer Constantinople. He will be given special powers and will make the truth seem false and vice versa. He will claim to be righteous and then he will claim prophet-hood and finally, divinity. From his features is that he will be blind in his right eye which is a definite proof that contradicts his claim to be Allah as it is a sign of imperfection. The word Kafir will be written between his eyes which every believer, literate or illiterate will recognise.)(Whoever memorises the first ten verses of soorat Al-Kahf will be protected from Dajjal.)(One should also seek refuge with Allah from the tribulations of the Dajjal after the last tashahhud in prayer.(Refer to supplications #55 & #56))
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocation for Allah's protection from the False Messiah

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لاَ أَعْلَمُ
duas.transliteration: allahumma inni a'udhu bika an ushrika bika wa'ana a'lamu wa'astaghfiruka lima la a'lamu
duas.translation: (shirk: to associate others with Allah in those things which are specific to Him. This can occur in belief, e.g. to believe that other than Allah has the power to benefit or harm, speech, e.g. to swear by other than Allah and action, e.g. to bow or prostrate to other than Allah.)(O Allah, I take refuge in You lest I should commit shirk with You knowingly and I seek Your forgiveness for what I do unknowingly.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocation for fear of Shirk

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ طَيْرَ إِلاَّ طَيْرُكَ، وَلاَ خَيْرَ إِلاَّ خَيْرُكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
duas.transliteration: allahumma la tayra ila tayruka wala khayra ila khayruka wala ilaha ghayruka
duas.translation: (This supplication is used whenever one initially thinks a casual event or occurrence to foretell good or evil, using it as a basis to determine which action he should undertake, but he then denounces such a link, relies on Allah and then says this supplication as an expiation for this act, since it falls under the category of shirk.)(O Allah, there is no omen but there is reliance on You, there is no good except Your good and none has the right to be worshipped except You.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocation against evil portent

duas.title_english: Hearing the cock's crow or the bray of a donkey
duas.text_arabic: إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ صِيَاحَ الدِّيَكَةِ فَاسْأَلُوا اللَّهَ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ؛ فَإِنَّهَا رَأَتْ مَلَكاً وَإِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ نَهِيقَ الْحِمَارِ فَتَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ؛ فَإِنَّهُ رَأَى شَيْطَاناً
duas.transliteration: idha sami'tum siyaha addiyakahi fas'alua allaha min fadlihi fa'innaha ra'at malakan wa'idha sami'tum nahiqa alhimari fata'awwadhua billahi mina ashshaytani fa'innahu ra'a shaytanan
duas.translation: If you hear the crow of a rooster, ask Allah for his bounty for it has seen an angel and if you hear the braying of an ass, seek refuge in Allah for it has seen a devil.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocation upon hearing the cock's crow or the bray of a donkey

duas.title_english: Hearing a dog barking in the night
duas.text_arabic: إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ نُبَاحَ الْكِلاَبِ وَنَهِيقَ الْحَمِيرِ بِاللَّيْلِ فَتَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنْهُنَّ؛ فَإِنَّهُنَّ يَرَيْنَ مَا لاَ تَرَوْنَ
duas.transliteration: idha sami'tum nubaha alkilabi wanahiqa alhamiri biallayli fata'awwadhua billahi minhunna fa'innahunna yarayna ma la tarawna
duas.translation: If you hear the barking of dogs or the braying of asses at night, seek refuge in Allah for they see what you do not.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocation upon hearing a dog barking in the night

duas.title_english: You fear you may afflict something with the evil eye
duas.text_arabic: إِذَا رَأَى أَحَدُكُم مِنْ أَخِيهِ، أَوْ مِنْ نَفْسِهِ، أَوْ مِنْ مَالِهِ مَا يُعْجِبُهُ فَلْيَدْعُ لَهُ بِالْبَرَكَةِ فَإِنَّ الْعَيْنَ حَقٌّ
duas.transliteration: idha ra'a ahadukum min akhihi aw min nafsihi aw min malihi ma yu'jibuhu falyad'u lahu bialbarakahi fa'inna al'ayna haqqun
duas.translation: If you see anything of your brother that pleases you, or of his person or of his property [then ask Allah to bless him in it] for the envious eye is real.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What to say when you fear you may afflict something with the evil eye

duas.text_arabic: أَعُوذُ بكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ الَّتِي لاَ يُجَاوِزُهُنَّ بَرٌّ وَلاَ فَاجِرٌ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ، وَبَرَأَ وَذَرَأَ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَعْرُجُ فيهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا ذَرَأَ فِي الْأَرْضِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا، وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتَنِ اللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ طَارِقٍ إِلاَّ طَارِقاً يَطْرُقُ بِخَيْرٍ يَا رَحْمَنُ
duas.transliteration: a'udhu bkalimati allahi attammati allati la yujawizuhunna barrun wala fajirun min sharri ma khalaqa wabara'a wadhara'a wamin sharri ma yanzilu mina assama'i wamin sharri ma ya'ruju fyha wamin sharri ma dhara'a fi al'ardi wamin sharri ma yakhruju minha wamin sharri fitani allayli walnnahari wamin sharri kulli tariqin ila tariqan yatruqu bikhayrin ya rahmanu
duas.translation: (I take refuge within Allah’s perfect words which no righteous or unrighteous person can transgress, from all the evil that He has created, made and originated. (I take refuge) from the evil that descends from the sky and the evil that rises up to it. (I take refuge) from the evil that is spread on Earth and the evil that springs from her, and I take refuge from the evil of the tribulations of night and day, and the evil of one who visits at night except the one who brings good, O Merciful One.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What to say to foil the devil's plots

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَاعِدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ، اللَّهُمَّ نَقِّنِي مِنْ خَطَايَايَ كَمَا يُنَقَّى الثَّوْبُ الْأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْني مِنْ خَطَايَايَ، بِالثَّلْجِ وَالْماءِ وَالْبَرَدِ
duas.transliteration: allahumma ba'id bayni wabayna khatayaya kama ba'adta bayna almashriqi walmaghribi allahumma naqqini min khatayaya kama yunaqqa aththawbu al'abyadu mina addanasi allahumma aghsilny min khatayaya bialththalji walma'i walbaradi
duas.translation: O Allah, distance me from my sins just as You have distanced The East from The West, O Allah, purify me of my sins as a white robe is purified of filth, O Allah, cleanse me of my sins with snow, water, and ice.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations for the beginning of the prayer

duas.text_arabic: سُبْحانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، وَتَبارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ
duas.transliteration: subhanaka allahumma wabihamdika watabaraka asmuka wata'ala jadduka wala ilaha ghayruka
duas.translation: How perfect You are O Allah, and I praise You. Blessed be Your name, and lofty is Your position and none has the right to be worshipped except You.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations for the beginning of the prayer

duas.text_arabic: وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ حَنِيفَاً وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ، إِنَّ صَلاَتِي، وَنُسُكِي، وَمَحْيَايَ، وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ وَبِذَلِكَ أُمِرْتُ وَأَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ المَلِكُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَنْتَ رَبِّي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَاعْتَرَفْتُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبي جَمِيعَاً إِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَاهْدِنِي لِأَحْسَنِ الأَخْلاقِ لاَ يَهْدِي لِأَحْسَنِها إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، وَاصْرِفْ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا، لاَ يَصْرِفُ عَنِّي سَيِّئَهَا إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، لَبَّيْكَ وَسَعْدَيْكَ، وَالخَيْرُ كُلُّهُ بِيَ دَيْكَ، وَالشَّ رُّ لَيْسَ إِلَيْ كَ، أَنَا بِكَ وَإِلَيْكَ، تَبارَكْتَ وَتَعَالَيْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتوبُ إِلَيْكَ
duas.transliteration: wajjahtu wajhiya lilladhi fatara assamawati wal'arda hanifan wama ana mina almushrikina inna salati wanusuki wamahyaya wamamati lillahi rabbi al'alamina la sharika lahu wabidhalika umirtu wa'ana mina almuslimina allahumma anta almaliku la ilaha ila anta anta rabbi wa'ana abduka dhalamtu nafsi wa'taraftu bidhanbi faghfir li dhunuby jami'an innahu la yaghfiru adhdhunwba ila anta wahdini li'ahsani al'akhlaqi la yahdi li'ahsaniha ila anta wasrif anni sayyi'aha la yasrifu anni sayyi'aha ila anta labbayka wasa'dayka walkhayru kulluhu biya dayka walshsha ru laysa ilay ka ana bika wa'ilayka tabarakta wata'alayta astaghfiruka wa'atwbu ilayka
duas.translation: (I have turned my face sincerely towards He who has brought forth the heavens and the Earth and I am not of those who associate (others with Allah). Indeed my prayer, my sacrifice, my life and my death are for Allah, Lord of the worlds, no partner has He, with this I am commanded and I am of the Muslims. O Allah, You are the Sovereign, none has the right to be worshipped except You. You are my Lord and I am Your servant, I have wronged my own soul and have acknowledged my sin, so forgive me all my sins for no one forgives sins except You. Guide me to the best of characters for none can guide to it other than You, and deliver me from the worst of characters for none can deliver me from it other than You. Here I am, in answer to Your call, happy to serve you. All good is within Your hands and evil does not stem from You. I exist by your will and will return to you. Blessed and High are You, I seek Your forgiveness and repent unto You.)(Allah does not create pure evil which does not have any good or contain any benefit, wisdom or mercy at all, nor does He punish anyone without having commited a sin. Something can be good in terms of its creation when viewed in a particular perspective and at the same time be evil when viewed in another way. Allah created the devil and by him, He tests His servants, so there are those who hate the devil, fight him and his way and they stand at enmity towards him and his followers and there are others who are at allegiance with the devil and follow his steps. So evil exists in His creatures by His will and wisdom, not in His actions or act of creating.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations for the beginning of the prayer

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ جِبْرَائِيلَ، وَمِيْكَائِيلَ، وَإِسْرَافِيلَ، فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ، عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ أَنْتَ تَحْكُمُ بَيْنَ عِبَادِكَ فِيمَا كَانُوا فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ اهْدِنِي لِمَا اخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ بِإِذْنِكَ إِنَّكَ تَهْدِي مَنْ تَشَاءُ إِلَى صِرَاطٍ مُسْتَقيمٍ
duas.transliteration: allahumma rabba jibra'ila wamika'ila wa'israfila fatira assamawati wal'ardi alima alghaybi walshshahadahi anta tahkumu bayna ibadika fima kanua fihi yakhtalifuna ahdini lima akhtulifa fihi mina alhaqqi bi'idhnika innaka tahdi man tasha'u ila siratin mustaqymin
duas.translation: (O Allah, Lord of Jibra-eel, Meeka-eel and Israfeel (great angles), Creator of the heavens and the Earth, Knower of the seen and the unseen. You are the arbitrator between Your servants in that which they have disputed. Guide me to the truth by Your leave, in that which they have differed, for verily You guide whom You will to a straight path.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations for the beginning of the prayer

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيرَاً، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيراً، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيراً، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثيراً، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثيراً، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثيراً، وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلاً ثَلاثاً أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ مِنْ نَفْخِهِ، وَنَفْثِهِ، وَهَمْزِهِ
duas.transliteration: allahu akbaru kabiran allahu akbaru kabiran allahu akbaru kabiran walhamdu lillahi kathyran walhamdu lillahi kathyran walhamdu lillahi kathyran wasubhana allahi bukrahan wa'asilan thalathan a'udhu billahi mina ashshaytani min nafkhihi wanafthihi wahamzihi
