duas.translation: (Allah is Most Great, Allah is Most Great, Allah is Most Great, much praise is for Allah, much praise is for Allah, much praise is for Allah, and I declare the perfection of Allah in the early morning and in the late afternoon.)(I take refuge with Allah from the devil, from his pride, his poetry and his madness.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations for the beginning of the prayer

duas.text_arabic: سُبْحانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ ثلاث مرَّاتٍ
duas.transliteration: subhana rabbiya al'adhimi thlath mrratin
duas.translation: (How perfect my Lord is, The Supreme.’(three times))
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations during Ruki' (bowing in prayer)

duas.text_arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا وَبِحَمْدِكَ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي
duas.transliteration: subhanaka allahumma rabbana wabihamdika allahumma aghfir li
duas.translation: How perfect You are O Allah, our Lord and I praise You. O Allah, forgive me.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations during Ruki' (bowing in prayer)

duas.text_arabic: سُبُّوُحٌ، قُدُّوسٌ، رَبُّ المَلاَئِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ
duas.transliteration: subbuwuhun quddusun rabbu almala'ikahi walrruhi
duas.translation: (Perfect and Holy (He is), Lord of the angles and the Rooh (i.e. Jibra-eel).)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations during Ruki' (bowing in prayer)

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ رَكَعْتُ، وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ، خَشَعَ لَكَ سَمْعِي، وَبَصَرِي، وَمُخِّي، وَعَ ظْمِي، وَعَصَبِي، وَمَا استَقَلَّتْ بِهِ قَدَمِي
duas.transliteration: allahumma laka raka'tu wabika amantu walaka aslamtu khasha'a laka sam'i wabasari wamukhkhi wa'a dhmi wa'asabi wama astaqallat bihi qadami
duas.translation: O Allah, unto You I have bowed, and in You I have believed, and to You I have submitted. My hearing, sight, mind, bones, tendons and what my feet carry are humbled before You.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations during Ruki' (bowing in prayer)

duas.text_arabic: سُبْحَانَ ذِي الْجَبَرُوتِ، وَالْمَلَكُوتِ، وَالْكِبْرِيَاءِ، وَالْعَظَمَةِ
duas.transliteration: subhana dhi aljabaruti walmalakuti walkibriya'i wal'adhamahi
duas.translation: How perfect He is, The Possessor of total power, sovereignty, magnificence and grandeur.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations during Ruki' (bowing in prayer)

duas.text_arabic: سَمِعَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ حَمِدَهُ
duas.transliteration: sami'a allahu liman hamidahu
duas.translation: (May Allah answer he who praises Him.)(This supplication is to be made while rising.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations for rising from the Ruki'

duas.text_arabic: رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ، حَمْداً كَثيراً طَيِّباً مُبارَكاً فِيهِ
duas.transliteration: rabbana walaka alhamdu hamdan kathyran tayyiban mubarakan fihi
duas.translation: Our Lord, for You is all praise, an abundant beautiful blessed praise.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations for rising from the Ruki'

duas.text_arabic: مِلْءَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الأَرْضِ، وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا، وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَيءٍ بَعْدُ أَهلَ الثَّناءِ وَالْمَجْدِ، أَحَقُّ مَا قَالَ الْعَبْدُ، وَكُلُّنَا لَكَ عَبْدٌ اللَّهُمَّ لاَ مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلاَ مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلاَ يَنْفَعُ ذَا الجَدِّ مِنْكَ الجَدُّ
duas.transliteration: mil'a assamawati wamil'a al'ardi wama baynahuma wamil'a ma shi'ta min shay'in ba'du ahla aththana'i walmajdi ahaqqu ma qala al'abdu wakulluna laka abdun allahumma la mani'a lima a'tayta wala mu'tiya lima mana'ta wala yanfa'u dha aljaddi minka aljaddu
duas.translation: (The heavens and the Earth and all between them abound with Your praises, and all that You will abounds with Your praises. O Possessor of praise and majesty, the truest thing a slave has said (of You) and we are all Your slaves. O Allah, none can prevent what You have willed to bestow and none can bestow what You have willed to prevent, and no wealth or majesty can benefit anyone, as from You is all wealth and majesty.)(This supplication is made optionally only in conjunction with the previous one.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations for rising from the Ruki'

duas.text_arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الأَعْلَى ثلاث مرَّاتٍ
duas.transliteration: subhana rabbiya al'a'la thlath mrratin
duas.translation: (How perfect my Lord is, The Most High.’(three times))
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations during Sujood

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ سَجَدْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ، وَلَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ، سَجَدَ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ، وَصَوَّرَهُ، وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ، تَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسنُ الْخَالِقينَ
duas.transliteration: allahumma laka sajadtu wabika amantu walaka aslamtu sajada wajhiya lilladhi khalaqahu wasawwarahu washaqqa sam'ahu wabasarahu tabaraka allahu ahsnu alkhaliqyna
duas.translation: O Allah, unto You I have prostrated and in You I have believed, and unto You I have submitted. My face has prostrated before He Who created it and fashioned it, and brought forth its faculties of hearing and seeing. Blessed is Allah, the Best of creators.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations during Sujood

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِرِضَاكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ، وَبِمُعَافَاتِكَ مِنْ عُقوبَتِكَ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْكَ، لاَ أُحْصِي ثَنَاءً عَلَيْكَ، أَنْتَ كَمَا أَثْنَيْتَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ
duas.transliteration: allahumma inni a'udhu biridaka min sakhatika wabimu'afatika min uqwbatika wa'a'udhu bika minka la uhsi thana'an alayka anta kama athnayta ala nafsika
duas.translation: O Allah, I take refuge within Your pleasure from Your displeasure and within Your pardon from Your punishment, and I take refuge in You from You. I cannot enumerate Your praise, You are as You have praised Yourself.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations during Sujood

duas.text_arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي، رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي
duas.transliteration: rabbi aghfir li rabbi aghfir li
duas.translation: My Lord forgive me, My Lord forgive me.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations for sitting between two prostrations

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَاجْبُرْنِي، وَعَافِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي، وَارْفَعْنِي
duas.transliteration: allahumma aghfir li warhamni wahdini wajburni wa'afini warzuqni warfa'ni
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive me, have mercy upon me, guide me, enrich me, give me health, grant me sustenance and raise my rank.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations for sitting between two prostrations

duas.title_english: Prostrating due to recitation of the Qur'an (1)
duas.text_arabic: سَجَدَ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ، وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ بِحَوْلِهِ وَقُوَّتِهِ، فَتَبارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الْخَالِقِينَ
duas.transliteration: sajada wajhiya lilladhi khalaqahu washaqqa sam'ahu wabasarahu bihawlihi waquwwatihi fatabaraka allahu ahsanu alkhaliqina
duas.translation: My face fell prostrate before He who created it and brought forth its faculties of hearing and seeing by His might and power.<< So Blessed is Allah, the best of creators.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Supplications for prostrating due to recitation of the Qur'an

duas.title_english: Prostrating due to recitation of the Qur'an (2)
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْتُبْ لِي بِهَا عِنْدَكَ أَجْراً، وَضَعْ عَنِّي بِهَا وِزْراً، وَاجْعَلْهَا لِي عِنْدَكَ ذُخْراً، وَتَقَبَّلْهَا مِنِّي كَمَا تَقَبَّلْتَهَا مِنْ عَبْدِكَ دَاوُدَ
duas.transliteration: allahumma aktub li biha indaka ajran wada anni biha wizran waj'alha li indaka dhukhran wataqabbalha minni kama taqabbaltaha min abdika dawuda
duas.translation: (O Allah, record for me a reward for this (prostration), and remove from me a sin. Save it for me and accept it from me just as You had accepted it from Your servant Dawood.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Supplications for prostrating due to recitation of the Qur'an

duas.text_arabic: التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ، وَالصَّلَواتُ، وَالطَّيِّباتُ، السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسولُهُ
duas.transliteration: attahiyyatu lillahi walssalawatu walttayyibatu assalamu alayka ayyuha annabiyyu warahmahu allahi wabarakatuhu assalamu alayna wa'ala ibadi allahi assalihina ashhadu an la ilaha ila allahu wa'ashhadu anna muhammadan abduhu waraswluhu
duas.translation: (At-tahiyyat is for Allah. All acts of worship and good deeds are for Him. Peace and the mercy and blessings of Allah be upon you O Prophet. Peace be upon us and all of Allah’s righteous servants. I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger.)(At-tahiyyat: all words which indicate the glorification of Allah. His eternal existence, His perfection and His sovereignty.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocation for At-Tashahhud (sitting in prayer)

duas.title_english: Blessings on the Prophet after the Tashahhud (1)
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أَزْواجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
duas.transliteration: allahumma salli ala muhammadin wa'ala azwajihi wadhurriyyatihi kama sallayta ala ali ibrahima wabarik ala muhammadin wa'ala azwajihi wadhurriyyatihi kama barakta ala ali ibrahima innaka hamidun majidun
duas.translation: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and upon the wives and descendants of Muhammad, just as You sent prayers upon the family of Ibraheem, and send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the wives and descendants of Muhammad, just as You sent blessings upon the family of Ibraheem. Verily, You are full of praise and majesty.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — How to recite blessings on the Prophet after the Tashahhud

duas.title_english: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer (1)
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُ مَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَمِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ، وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ
duas.transliteration: allahu ma inni a'udhu bika min adhabi alqabri wamin adhabi jahannama wamin fitnahi almahya walmamati wamin sharri fitnahi almasihi addajjali
duas.translation: (O Allah, I take refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, from the torment of the Fire, from the trials and tribulations of life and death and from the evil affliction of Al-Maseeh Ad-Dajjal.)(Al-Maseeh Ad-Dajjal: among the great signs of the last hour and the greatest trials to befall mankind, which every Prophet has warned about. Most of mankind will follow him. He will appear from Asbahan, Iran at the time when the Muslims will conquer Constantinople. He will be given special powers and will make the truth seem false and vice versa. He will claim to be righteous and then he will claim prophethood and finally, divinity. From his features is that he will be blind in his right eye which is a definite proof that contradicts his claim to be Allah as it is a sign of imperfection. The word Kafir will be written between his eyes which every believer, literate or illiterate will recognise.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer

duas.title_english: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer (2)
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَأَعوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ، وَأَعوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْمَأْثَمِ وَالْمَغْرَمِ
duas.transliteration: allahumma inni a'wdhu bika min adhabi alqabri wa'a'wdhu bika min fitnahi almasihi addajjali wa'a'wdhu bika min fitnahi almahya walmamati allahumma inni a'wdhu bika mina alma'thami walmaghrami
duas.translation: O Allah, I take refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, and I take refuge in You from the temptation and trial of Al-Maseeh Ad-Dajjal, and I take refuge in You from the trials and tribulations of life and death. O Allah, I take refuge in You from sin and debt.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer

duas.title_english: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer (3)
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْماً كَثِيراً، وَلاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَارْحَمْنِي، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الغَفورُ الرَّحيمُ
duas.transliteration: allahumma inni dhalamtu nafsi dhulman kathiran wala yaghfiru adhdhunwba ila anta faghfir li maghfirahan min indika warhamni innaka anta alghafwru arrahymu
duas.translation: (O Allah, I have indeed oppressed my soul excessively and none can forgive sin except You, so forgive me a forgiveness from Yourself and have mercy upon me. Surely, You are The Most-Forgiving, The Most-Merciful.)(From Yourself: i.e. from Your innermost grace without deserving it and a forgiveness which is befitting to your tremendous generosity.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer

duas.title_english: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer (4)
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ، وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ، وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَفْتُ، وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ، وَأَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: allahumma aghfir li ma qaddamtu wama akhkhartu wama asrartu wama a'lantu wama asraftu wama anta a'lamu bihi minni anta almuqaddimu wa'anta almu'akhkhiru la ilaha ila anta
duas.translation: (O Allah, forgive me for those sins which have come to pass as well as those which shall come to pass, and those I have committed in secret as well as those I have made public, and where I have exceeded all bounds as well as those things about which You are more knowledgeable. You are Al-Muqaddim and Al-Mu-akhkhir. None has the right to be worshipped except You.)(Meaning of Al-Muqaddim and Al-Mu-akhkhir: Allah puts forward and favours whom He wills from amongst His creation just as He defers and holds back whom He wills in accordance to His wisdom. E.g. Favouring man over the rest of creation, favouring the Prophets over the rest of mankind, favouring Muhammad over all the Prophets and Messengers…etc.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer

duas.title_english: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer (5)
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka aljannaha wa'a'udhu bika mina annari
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You to grant me Paradise and I take refuge in You from the Fire.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer

duas.title_english: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer (6)
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِعِلْمِكَ الغَيْبَ وَقُدْرَتِكَ عَلَى الْخَلقِ أَحْيِنِي مَا عَلِمْتَ الْحَيَاةَ خَيْراً لِي، وَتَوَفَّنِي إِذَا عَلِمْتَ الْوَفَاةَ خَيْراً لِي، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَشْيَتَكَ فِي الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ كَلِمَةَ الْحَقِّ فِي الرِّضَا وَالْغَضَبِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ الْقَصْدَ فِي الْغِنَى وَالْفَقْرِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ نَعِيماً لاَ يَنْفَدُ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ قُرَّةَ عَيْنٍ لاَ تَنْقَطِعُ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ الرِّضَا بَعْدَ الْقَضَاءِ، وَأَسْ أَلُكَ بَرْدَ الْعَيْشِ بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ لَذَّةَ النَّظَرِ إِلَى وَجْهِكَ، وَالشَّوْقَ إِلَى لِقائِكَ فِي غَيرِ ضَرَّاءَ مُضِرَّةٍ، وَلاَ فِتْنَةٍ مُضِلَّةٍ، اللَّهُمَّ زَيِّنَا بِزِينَةِ الإِيمَانِ، وَاجْعَلْنَا هُدَاةً مُهْتَدِينَ
duas.transliteration: allahumma bi'ilmika alghayba waqudratika ala alkhalqi ahyini ma alimta alhayaha khayran li watawaffani idha alimta alwafaha khayran li allahumma inni as'aluka khashyataka fi alghaybi walshshahadahi wa'as'aluka kalimaha alhaqqi fi arrida walghadabi wa'as'aluka alqasda fi alghina walfaqri wa'as'aluka na'iman la yanfadu wa'as'aluka qurraha aynin la tanqati'u wa'as'aluka arrida ba'da alqada'i wa'as aluka barda al'ayshi ba'da almawti wa'as'aluka ladhdhaha annadhari ila wajhika walshshawqa ila liqa'ika fi ghayri darra'a mudirrahin wala fitnahin mudillahin allahumma zayyina bizinahi al'imani waj'alna hudahan muhtadina
duas.translation: O Allah, by Your knowledge of the unseen and Your power over creation, keep me alive so long as You know such life to be good for me and take me if You know death to be better for me. O Allah, make me fearful of You whether in secret or in public and I ask You to make me true in speech, in times of pleasure and anger.I ask you to make me moderate in times of wealth and poverty and I ask You for everlasting bliss and joy which will never cease.I ask You to make me pleased with what You have decreed and for an easy life after death.I ask You for the sweetness of looking upon Your Face and a longing to encounter You in a manner which does not entail a calamity which will bring about harm nor a trial which will cause deviation. O Allah, beautify us with the adornment of faith and make us of those who guide and are rightly guided.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer

duas.title_english: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer (7)
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ يَا أَللَّهُ بِأَنَّكَ الْوَاحِدُ الْأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الَّذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يولَدْ، وَلَمْ يَكنْ لَهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ، أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي ذُنُوبِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِّيمُ
duas.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka ya allahu bi'annaka alwahidu al'ahadu assamadu alladhi lam yalid walam ywlad walam yakn lahu kufuan ahadun an taghfira li dhunubi innaka anta alghafuru arrahhimu
duas.translation: (O Allah, I ask You O Allah, as You are The One, The Only, AS-Samad, The One who begets not, nor was He begotten and there is none like unto Him that You forgive me my sins for verily You are The Oft-Forgiving, Most-Merciful.)(AS-Samad: The Self-Sufficient Master, Possessor of perfect attributes whom all of creation turn to in all their needs.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer

duas.title_english: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer (8)
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، الْمَنَّانُ، يَا بَدِيعَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَا ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ، يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka bi'anna laka alhamda la ilaha ila anta wahdaka la sharika laka almannanu ya badi'a assamawati wal'ardi ya dha aljalali wal'ikrami ya hayyu ya qayyumu inni as'aluka aljannaha wa'a'udhu bika mina annari
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You as unto You is all praise, none has the right to be worshipped except You, alone, without partner. You are the Benefactor. O Originator of the heavens and the Earth, O Possessor of majesty and honour, O Ever Living, O Self-Subsisting and Supporter of all, verily I ask You for Paradise and I take refuge with You from the Fire.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer

duas.title_english: Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer (9)
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّي أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ الْأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ الَّذِي لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ
duas.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka bi'annay ashhadu annaka anta allahu la ilaha ila anta al'ahadu assamadu alladhi lam yalid walam yulad walam yakun lahu kufuan ahadun
duas.translation: (O Allah, I ask You, as I bear witness that You are Allah, none has the right to be worshipped except You, The One, AS-Samad Who begets not nor was He begotten and there is none like unto Him.)(AS-Samad: The Self-Sufficient Master, Possessor of perfect attributes whom all of creation turn to in all their needs.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations after the final Tash-ahhud and before ending the prayer

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ، وَعَافِنِي فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ، وَتَوَلَّنِي فِيمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ، وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَقِنِي شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ؛ فَإِنَّكَ تَقْضِي وَلاَ يُقْضَى عَلَيْكَ، إِنَّهُ لاَ يَذِلُّ مَنْ وَالَيْتَ، وَلاَ يَعِزُّ مَنْ عَادَيْتَ، تَبارَكْتَ رَبَّنا وَتَعَالَيْتَ
duas.transliteration: allahumma ahdini fiman hadayta wa'afini fiman afayta watawallani fiman tawallayta wabarik li fima a'tayta waqini sharra ma qadayta fa'innaka taqdi wala yuqda alayka innahu la yadhillu man walayta wala ya'izzu man adayta tabarakta rabbana wata'alayta
duas.translation: (O Allah, guide me along with those whom You have guided, pardon me along with those whom You have pardoned, be an ally to me along with those whom You are an ally to and bless for me that which You have bestowed. Protect me from the evil You have decreed for verily You decree and none can decree over You.For surety, he whom you show allegiance to is never abased and he whom You take as an enemy is never honoured and mighty. O our Lord, Blessed and Exalted are You.)(Evil you have decreed: Allah does not create pure evil which does not have any good or contain any benefit, wisdom or mercy at all, nor does He punish anyone without having commited a sin. Something can be good in terms of its creation when viewed in a particular perspective and at the same time be evil when viewed in another way.Allah created the devil and by him, He tests His servants, so there are those who hate the devil, fight him and his way and they stand at enmity towards him and his followers and there are others who are at allegiance with the devil and follow his steps. So evil exists in His creatures by His will and wisdom, not in His actions or act of creating.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations for Qunut in the Witr prayer

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِيَّاكَ نعْبُدُ، وَلَكَ نُصَلِّي وَنَسْجُدُ، وَإِلَيْكَ نَسْعَى وَنَحْفِدُ، نَرْجُو رَحْمَتَكَ، وَنَخْشَى عَذَابَكَ، إِنَّ عَذَابَكَ بِالكَافِرِينَ مُلْحَقٌ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْتَعينُكَ، وَنَسْتَغْفِرُكَ، وَنُثْنِي عَلَيْكَ الْخَيْرَ، وَلاَ نَكْفُرُكَ، وَنُؤْمِنُ بِكَ، وَنَخْضَعُ لَكَ، وَنَخْلَعُ مَنْ يَكْفرُكَ
duas.transliteration: allahumma iyyaka n'budu walaka nusalli wanasjudu wa'ilayka nas'a wanahfidu narju rahmataka wanakhsha adhabaka inna adhabaka bialkafirina mulhaqun allahumma inna nasta'ynuka wanastaghfiruka wanuthni alayka alkhayra wala nakfuruka wanu'minu bika wanakhda'u laka wanakhla'u man yakfruka
duas.translation: O Allah, it is You we worship, and unto You we pray and prostrate, and towards You we hasten and You we serve. We hope for Your mercy and fear Your punishment, verily Your punishment will fall upon the disbelievers.O Allah, we seek Your aid and ask Your pardon, we praise You with all good and do not disbelieve in You.We believe in You and submit unto You, and we disown and reject those who disbelieve in You.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations for Qunut in the Witr prayer

duas.text_arabic: سُبْحَانَ المَلِكِ القُدُّوسِ ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ والثَّالِثَةُ يَجْهَرُ بها ويَمُدُّ بها صَوتَهُ يقولُ رَبِّ الْمَلاَئِكَةِ وَالرُّوحِ
duas.transliteration: subhana almaliki alquddusi thlatha mrratin walththalithahu yajharu bha wyamuddu bha sawtahu yqwlu rabbi almala'ikahi walrruhi
duas.translation: (How perfect The King, The Holy One is.(three times) on the third time he would raise his voice, elongate it and add: (Lord of the angles and the Rooh (i.e. Jibra-eel).))
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What to say immediately following the Witr prayer

duas.text_arabic: مَنْ كَانَ آخِرُ كَلاَمِهِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ دَخَلَ الْجَنَّةَ
duas.transliteration: man kana akhiru kalamihi la ilaha ila allahu dakhala aljannaha
duas.translation: i.e. those around the sick should instruct and encourage him to say the shahadah. (He whose last words are: (None has the right to be worshipped except Allah.) will enter Paradise.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What to encourage the dying person to say

duas.title_english: Closing the eyes of the dead
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِفُلاَنٍ بِاسْمِهِ وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُ فِي الْمَهْدِيِّينَ، وَاخْلُفْهُ فِي عَقِبِهِ فِي الْغَابِرِينَ، وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلَهُ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ، وَافْسَحْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ، وَنَوِّرْ لَهُ فِيهِ
duas.transliteration: allahumma aghfir lifulanin biasmihi warfa darajatahu fi almahdiyyina wakhlufhu fi aqibihi fi alghabirina waghfir lana walahu ya rabba al'alamina wafsah lahu fi qabrihi wanawwir lahu fihi
duas.translation: (O Allah, forgive -here the name of the deceased is mentioned- and raise his rank among the rightly guided, and be a successor to whom he has left behind, and forgive us and him O Lord of the worlds. Make spacious his grave and illuminate it for him.)(A successor: one who succeeds another due to the latter’s absence or death. This is the correct meaning of the word khaleefah; thus, it is incorrect to believe that Adam is the khaleefah (vicegerent, as is commonly translated) of Allah on earth because Allah is never absent, and will never die. This supplication proves the correct understanding of this term and shows that Allah succeeds us and guards whom we leave behind when we die or are absent (also refer to supplication #198).)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocation for closing the eyes of the dead

duas.title_english: The dead in the Funeral prayer (1)
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ، وَعَافِهِ، وَاعْفُ عَنْهُ، وَأَكْرِمْ نُزُلَهُ، وَوَسِّعْ مُدْخَلَهُ، وَاغْسِلْهُ بِالْمَاءِ وَالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ، وَنَقِّهِ مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ، وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَاراً خَيْراً مِنْ دَارِهِ، وَأَهْلاً خَيْراً مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، وَزَوْجَاً خَيْراً مِنْ زَوْجِهِ، وَأَدْخِلْهُ الْجَنَّةَ، وَأَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: allahumma aghfir lahu warhamhu wa'afihi wa'fu anhu wa'akrim nuzulahu wawassi mudkhalahu waghsilhu bialma'i walththalji walbaradi wanaqqihi mina alkhataya kama naqqayta aththawba al'abyada mina addanasi wa'abdilhu daran khayran min darihi wa'ahlan khayran min ahlihi wazawjan khayran min zawjihi wa'adkhilhu aljannaha wa'a'idhhu min adhabi alqabri wa'adhabi annari
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive and have mercy upon him, excuse him and pardon him, and make honourable his reception. Expand his entry, and cleanse him with water, snow, and ice, and purify him of sin as a white robe is purified of filth. Exchange his home for a better home, and his family for a better family, and his spouse for a better spouse. Admit him into the Garden, protect him from the punishment of the grave and the torment of the Fire.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations for the dead in the Funeral prayer

duas.title_english: The dead in the Funeral prayer (2)
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا وَمَيِّتِنَا، وَشَاهِدِنَا وَغَائِبِنَا، وَصَغِيرِنَا وَكَبيرِنَا، وَذَكَرِنَا وَأُنْثَانَا اللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَحْيَيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَأَحْيِهِ عَلَى الْإِسْلاَمِ، وَمَنْ تَوَفَّيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَتَوَفَّهُ عَلَى الإِيمَانِ، اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تَحْرِمْنَا أَجْرَهُ، وَلاَ تُضِلَّنَا بَعْدَهُ
duas.transliteration: allahumma aghfir lihayyina wamayyitina washahidina wagha'ibina wasaghirina wakabyrina wadhakarina wa'unthana allahumma man ahyaytahu minna fa'ahyihi ala al'islami waman tawaffaytahu minna fatawaffahu ala al'imani allahumma la tahrimna ajrahu wala tudillana ba'dahu
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive our living and our dead, those present and those absent, our young and our old, our males and our females. O Allah, whom amongst us You keep alive, then let such a life be upon Islam, and whom amongst us You take unto Yourself, then let such a death be upon faith. O Allah, do not deprive us of his reward and do not let us stray after him.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations for the dead in the Funeral prayer

duas.title_english: The dead in the Funeral prayer (3)
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ فُلاَنَ بْنَ فُلاَنٍ فِي ذِمَّتِكَ، وَحَبْلِ جِوَارِكَ، فَقِهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْقَبْرِ، وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ، وَأَنْتَ أَهْلُ الْوَفَاءِ وَالْحَقِّ، فَاغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الغَفُورُ الرَّحيمُ
duas.transliteration: allahumma inna fulana bna fulanin fi dhimmatika wahabli jiwarika faqihi min fitnahi alqabri wa'adhabi annari wa'anta ahlu alwafa'i walhaqqi faghfir lahu warhamhu innaka anta alghafuru arrahymu
duas.translation: O Allah, so-and-so is under Your care and protection so protect him from the trial of the grave and torment of the Fire. Indeed You are faithful and truthful. Forgive and have mercy upon him, surely You are The Oft-Forgiving, The Most-Merciful.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations for the dead in the Funeral prayer

duas.title_english: The dead in the Funeral prayer (4)
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَبْدُكَ وَابْنُ أَمَتِكَ احْتَاجَ إِلَى رَحْمَتِكَ، وَأَنْتَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْ عَذَابِهِ، إِنْ كَانَ مُحْسِناً فَزِدْ فِي حَسَنَاتِهِ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مُسِيئاً فَتَجَاوَزْ عَنْهُ
duas.transliteration: allahumma abduka wabnu amatika ahtaja ila rahmatika wa'anta ghaniyyun an adhabihi in kana muhsinan fazid fi hasanatihi wa'in kana musi'an fatajawaz anhu
duas.translation: O Allah, Your servant and the son of Your maidservant is in need of Your mercy and You are without need of his punishment. If he was righteous then increase his reward and if he was wicked then look over his sins.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations for the dead in the Funeral prayer

duas.title_english: A child in the Funeral prayer (1)
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِذْهُ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ وإن قال اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ فَرَطاً وَذُخْراً لِوَالِدَيْهِ، وَشَفِيعاً مُجَاباً، اللَّهُمَّ ثَقِّلْ بِهِ مَوَازِينَهُمَا، وَأَعْظِمْ بِهِ أُجورَهُمَا، وَأَلْحِقْهُ بِصَالِحِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، وَاجْعَلْهُ فِي كَفَالَةِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَقِهِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ، وَأَبْدِلْهُ دَاراً خَيْراً مِنْ دَارِهِ، وَأَهْلاً خَيْراً مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِأَسْلاَفِنَا، وَأَفْرَاطِنَا، وَمَنْ سَبَقَنَا بِالْإِيمَانِ إن قال ذلك فَحَسَنٌ
duas.transliteration: allahumma a'idhhu min adhabi alqabri w'n qal allahumma aj'alhu faratan wadhukhran liwalidayhi washafi'an mujaban allahumma thaqqil bihi mawazinahuma wa'a'dhim bihi ujwrahuma wa'alhiqhu bisalihi almu'minina waj'alhu fi kafalahi ibrahima waqihi birahmatika adhaba aljahimi wa'abdilhu daran khayran min darihi wa'ahlan khayran min ahlihi allahumma aghfir li'aslafina wa'afratina waman sabaqana bial'imani n qal dhlk fahasanun
duas.translation: O Allah, protect him from the torment of the grave . [it is also good to say] O Allah, make him a precursor, a forerunner and a treasure for his parents and an answered intercessor. O Allah, make him weigh heavily in their scales (of good) and magnify their reward. Make him join the righteous of the believers. Place him in the care of Ibrahim. Save him by Your mercy from the torment of Hell. Give him a home better than his home and a family better than his family. O Allah, forgive those who have gone (i.e. passed away) before us, our children lost (by death), and those who have preceded us in Faith.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations for a child in the Funeral prayer

duas.title_english: A child in the Funeral prayer (2)
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْهُ لَنَا فَرَطاً، وَسَلَفاً، وَأَجْراً
duas.transliteration: allahumma aj'alhu lana faratan wasalafan wa'ajran
duas.translation: O Allah, make him for us a precursor,a forerunner and a cause of reward
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations for a child in the Funeral prayer

duas.text_arabic: إِنَّ للَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ، وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَى، وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ عِنْدَهُ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمَّى فَلْتَصْبِرْ وَلْتَحْتَسِبْ وَإِنْ قَالَ أَعْظَمَ اللَّهُ أَجْرَكَ، وَأَحْسَنَ عَزَاءَكَ، وَغَفَرَ لِمَيِّتِكَ فَحَسَنٌ
duas.transliteration: inna lahi ma akhadha walahu ma a'ta wakullu shay'in indahu bi'ajalin musamma faltasbir waltahtasib wa'in qala a'dhama allahu ajraka wa'ahsana aza'aka waghafara limayyitika fahasanun
duas.translation: (Verily to Allah, belongs what He took and to Him belongs what He gave, and everything with Him has an appointed time…and then he ordered for her to be patient and hope for Allah’s reward.)(The words (faltasbir waltahtasib) are commands in the feminine 3rd person form, so they will need to be changed in respect to whom is being addressed.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocation for the bereaved

duas.title_english: When placing the dead in his grave
duas.text_arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى سُنَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: bismi allahi wa'ala sunnahi rasuli allahi
duas.translation: In the name of Allah and upon the sunnah of the Messenger of Allah.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocation to be recited when placing the dead in his grave

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ ثَبِّتْهُ
duas.transliteration: allahumma aghfir lahu allahumma thabbithu
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive him. O Allah, strengthen him
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocation to be recited after burying the dead

duas.text_arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ، مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لاَحِقُونَ، وَيَرْحَمُ اللَّهُ الْمُسْتَقدِمِينَ مِنَّا وَالْمُسْتأْخِرِينَ أَسْاَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ
duas.transliteration: assalamu alaykum ahla addiyari mina almu'minina walmuslimina wa'inna in sha'a allahu bikum lahiquna wayarhamu allahu almustaqdimina minna walmust'khirina asalu allaha lana walakumu al'afiyaha
duas.translation: Peace be upon you all, O inhabitants of the graves, amongst the believers and the Muslims. Verily we will, Allah willing, be united with you, we ask Allah for well-being for us and you.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocation for visiting the graves

duas.text_arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ العُرُوقُ، وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
duas.transliteration: dhahaba adhdhama'u wabtallati al'uruqu wathabata al'ajru in sha'a allahu
duas.translation: The thirst has gone and the veins are quenched, and reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations for breaking the fast

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي وَسِعَتْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي
duas.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka birahmatika allati wasi'at kulla shay'in an taghfira li
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy which envelopes all things, that You forgive me.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations for breaking the fast

duas.title_english: A family who invites you to break your fast with them
duas.text_arabic: أَفْطَرَ عِنْدَكُمُ الصَّائِمُونَ، وَأَكَلَ طَعَامَكُمُ الْأَبْرَارُ، وَصَلَّتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ
duas.transliteration: aftara indakumu assa'imuna wa'akala ta'amakumu al'abraru wasallat alaykumu almala'ikahu
duas.translation: May the fasting break their fast in your home, and may the dutiful and pious eat your food, and may the angles send prayers upon you.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocation for a family who invites you to break your fast with them

duas.title_english: You are fasting and someone is rude to you
duas.text_arabic: إِنِّي صَائِمٌ، إِنِّي صَائِمٌ
duas.transliteration: inni sa'imun inni sa'imun
duas.translation: I am fasting, I am fasting.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What to say when you are fasting and someone is rude to you

duas.title_english: You meet an adversary or a powerful ruler (1)
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِي نُحُورِهِم، وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرُورِهِمْ
duas.transliteration: allahumma inna naj'aluka fi nuhurihim wana'udhu bika min shururihim
duas.translation: O Allah, we place You before them and we take refuge in You from their evil.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations for when you meet an adversary or a powerful ruler.

duas.title_english: You meet an adversary or a powerful ruler (2)
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ عَضُدِي، وَأَنْتَ نَصِيرِي، بِكَ أَحُولُ وَبِكَ أَصُولُ، وَبِكَ أُقاتِلُ
duas.transliteration: allahumma anta adudi wa'anta nasiri bika ahulu wabika asulu wabika uqatilu
duas.translation: O Allah, You are my supporter and You are my helper, by You I move and by You I attack and by You I battle.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations for when you meet an adversary or a powerful ruler.

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ربَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ، وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، كُنْ لِي جَاراً مِنْ فُلاَنِ بْنِ فُلاَنٍ، وَأَحْزَابِهِ مِنْ خَلاَئِقِكَ، أَنْ يَفْرُطَ عَلَيَّ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ أَوْ يَطْغَى، عَزَّ جَارُكَ، وَجَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: allahumma rbba assamawati assab'i warabba al'arshi al'adhimi kun li jaran min fulani bni fulanin wa'ahzabihi min khala'iqika an yafruta alayya ahadun minhum aw yatgha azza jaruka wajalla thana'uka wala ilaha ila anta
duas.translation: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens, Lord of the Magnificent Throne, be for me a support against [such and such a person] and his helpers from among your creatures, lest any of them abuse me or do me wrong. Mighty is your patronage and glorious are your praises. There is none worthy of worship but you.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations against the oppression of rulers

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُ أَعَزُّ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ جَمِيعاً، اللَّهُ أَعَزُّ مِمَّا أَخَافُ وَأَحْذَرُ، أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ، الْمُمْسِكِ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ أَنْ يَقَعْنَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ، مِنْ شَرِّ عَبْدِكَ فُلاَنٍ، وَجُنُودِهِ وَأَتْبَاعِهِ وَأَشْيَاعِهِ، مِنْ الْجِنِّ وَالإِنْسِ، اللَّهُمَّ كُنْ لِي جَاراً مِنْ شَرِّهِمْ، جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ وَعَزَّ جَارُكَ، وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ ثلاثَ مرَّاتٍ
duas.transliteration: allahu akbaru allahu a'azzu min khalqihi jami'an allahu a'azzu mimma akhafu wa'ahdharu a'udhu billahi alladhi la ilaha ila huwa almumsiki assamawati assab'i an yaqa'na ala al'ardi ila bi'idhnihi min sharri abdika fulanin wajunudihi wa'atba'ihi wa'ashya'ihi min aljinni wal'insi allahumma kun li jaran min sharrihim jalla thana'uka wa'azza jaruka watabaraka asmuka wala ilaha ghayruka thlatha mrratin
duas.translation: Allah is the Most Great, Mightier than all His creation. He is Mightier than what fear and dread. I seek refuge in Allah, Who there is none worthy of worship but Him. He is the One Who holds the seven heavens from falling upon the earth except by His command. [I seek refuge in You Allah] from the evil of Your slave [name of the person], and his helpers, his followers and his supporters from among the jinn and mankind. O Allah, be my support against their evil. Glorious Your praises and mighty is Your patronage. Blessed is Your Name, there is no true God but You. (Recite three times in Arabic)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations against the oppression of rulers

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ، سَرِيعَ الْحِسَابِ، اهْزِمِ الأَحْزَابَ، اللَّهُمَّ اهزِمْهُمْ وَزَلْزِلْهُمْ
duas.transliteration: allahumma munzila alkitabi sari'a alhisabi ahzimi al'ahzaba allahumma ahzimhum wazalzilhum
duas.translation: O Allah, Revealer of the Book, Swift at reckoning, defeat the confederates. O Allah, defeat them and convulse them.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocation against an enemy

duas.title_english: You fear people may harm you
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِيهِمْ بِمَا شِئْتَ
duas.transliteration: allahumma akfinihim bima shi'ta
duas.translation: O Allah, protect me from them with what You choose.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What to say if you fear people may harm you

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْ أَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا
duas.transliteration: allahumma inni as aluka khayraha wa'a'udhu bika min sharriha
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for it’s goodness and I take refuge with You from it’s evil.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations for when the wind blows

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ
duas.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka khayraha wakhayra ma fiha wakhayra ma ursilat bihi wa'a'udhu bika min sharriha washarri ma fiha washarri ma ursilat bihi
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for it’s goodness, the good within it, and the good it was sent with, and I take refuge with You from it’s evil, the evil within it, and from the evil it was sent with.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocations for when the wind blows

duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْأَمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ، وَالسَّلاَمَةِ وَالْإِسْلاَمِ، وَالتَّوْفِيقِ لِمَا تُحِبُّ رَبَّنَا وَتَرْضَى، رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ
duas.transliteration: allahu akbaru allahumma ahillahu alayna bial'amni wal'imani walssalamahi wal'islami walttawfiqi lima tuhibbu rabbana watarda rabbuna warabbuka allahu
duas.translation: Allah is the greatest. O Allah, let the crescent loom above us in safety, faith, peace, and Islam, and in agreement with all that You love and pleases You. Our Lord and your Lord is Allah.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocation for sighting the new moon

duas.title_english: You see someone afflicted by misfortune
duas.text_arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلاَكَ بِهِ، وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلاً
duas.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi alladhi afani mimma abtalaka bihi wafaddalani ala kathirin mimman khalaqa tafdilan
duas.translation: All praise is for Allah Who saved me from that which He tested you with and Who most certainly favoured me over much of His creation.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What to say if you see someone afflicted by misfortune

duas.text_arabic: مَنْ قَالَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ غُرِسَتْ لَهُ نَخْلَةٌ فِي الْجَنَّةِ
duas.transliteration: man qala subhana allahi al'adhimi wabihamdihi ghurisat lahu nakhlahun fi aljannahi
duas.translation: (Jabbir related that the Prophet said: ‘Whoever says: (How perfect Allah is . The Supreme, and I praise Him.) a palm tree is planted for him in paradise.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — The excellence of remembering Allah

duas.text_arabic: الباقيات الصالحات سبحان الله والحمد لله، ولا إله إلا الله،والله أكبر،و لا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله
duas.transliteration: albaqyat alsalhat sbhan allah walhmd lh wla lh la allahwallah kbrw la hwl wla qwh la ballah
duas.translation: The good deeds which endure are 'Glorified is Allah', and 'The praise is for Allah', and 'but There is none worthy of worship Allah', and 'Allah is the Most Great', and 'There is no power and no might except by Allah
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — The excellence of remembering Allah

duas.title_english: Someone who does good to you
duas.text_arabic: جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْراً
duas.transliteration: jazaka allahu khayran
duas.translation: (If someone does you a favour and you say: (May Allah reward you with goodness.) then you have indeed excelled in praising him.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocation for someone who does good to you

duas.title_english: Someone who tells you I love you for the sake of Allah
duas.text_arabic: أَحَبَّكَ الَّذِي أَحْبَبْتَنِي لَهُ
duas.transliteration: ahabbaka alladhi ahbabtani lahu
duas.translation: May He, for whom you have loved me, love you.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocation for someone who tells you I love you for the sake of Allah

duas.title_english: Someone who offers you a share of his wealth
duas.text_arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ
duas.transliteration: baraka allahu laka fi ahlika wamalika
duas.translation: May Allah bless for you, your family and wealth.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocation for someone who offers you a share of his wealth

duas.text_arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ، وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ، وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لاِ يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: la ilaha ila allahu wahdahu la sharika lahu lahu almulku walahu alhamdu yuhyi wayumitu wahuwa hayyun lai yamutu biyadihi alkhayru wahuwa ala kulli shay'in qadirun
duas.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is living and does not die. In His hand is all good and He is over all things, omnipotent.
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — Invocation for entering a market

duas.text_arabic: ثَلاَثٌ مَنْ جَمَعَهُنَّ فَقَدْ جَمَعَ الْإِيمَانَ الْإِنْصَافُ مِنْ نَفْسِكَ، وَبَذْلُ السَّلاَمِ لِلْعَالَمِ، وَالْإِنْفَاقُ مِنَ الإِقْتَارِ
duas.transliteration: thalathun man jama'ahunna faqad jama'a al'imana al'insafu min nafsika wabadhlu assalami lil'alami wal'infaqu mina al'iqtari
duas.translation: (Aammar said: ‘Three characteristics, whoever combines them, has completed his faith: to be just, to spread greetings to all people and to spend (charitably) out of the little you have.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — spreading the greetings of Salam (Peace)

duas.title_english: Reply to a disbeliever if he says Salam to you
duas.text_arabic: إذَا سَلَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ فَقُولُوا وَعَلَيْكُمْ
duas.transliteration: dha sallama alaykum ahlu alkitabi faqulua wa'alaykum
duas.translation: (When the people of the Book greet you, reply by saying: (And upon you.))
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — How to reply to a disbeliever if he says Salam to you

duas.title_english: What a Muslim should say when he is praised
duas.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنِي بِمَا يَقُولُونَ، وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا لاَ يَعْلَمُونَ، وَاجْعَلْنِي خَيْراً مِمَّا يَظُّنُّونَ
duas.transliteration: allahumma la tu'akhidhni bima yaquluna waghfir li ma la ya'lamuna waj'alni khayran mimma yadhdhunnuna
duas.translation: O Allah, do not call me to account for what they say and forgive me for what they have no knowledge of [and make me better than they imagine].
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What a Muslim should say when he is praised

duas.text_arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُمَّ مِنْكَ وَلَكَ اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنِّي
duas.transliteration: bismi allahi wallahu akbaru allahumma minka walaka allahumma taqabbal minni
duas.translation: (In the name of Allah, and Allah is the greatest. O Allah, (it is) from You and belongs to You, O Allah, accept this from me.)
duas.source: Hisnul Muslim — What to say when slaughtering or sacrificing an animal
